WalletHub ran the numbers. When you add it all up — gross receipts, property taxes, income taxes — New Mexico takes a huge chunk of your income. Only three states take more.
Then Mark pulled one comparison that tells the whole story. A home in Angel Fire costs nearly double the property taxes as the same home in Aspen. Not the other way around.
Meanwhile, 98 companies have fled Colorado since 2019. 13,000 jobs gone. Mark connects the dots to what's coming to New Mexico if nothing changes.

It was not a defense.
When your own party is the one telling victims to call the hotline, there's no coming back from that.

JD Vance sat across from Iran for 21 hours. They said no to everything — enrichment, facilities, proxies, the strait.
Trump's response was a Navy blockade. CBS polling says 87% of Americans support it. Douglas Murray called the entire operation "an amazing strategic success."
Then Tom Friedman went on CNN and admitted he's "torn" about whether America should win — because it might help Trump. You need to hear him say it.

📉 **TUCKER'S 47-POINT FREEFALL — AND HE STILL DOESN'T GET IT**

Mark breaks down what happened — and why Tucker, Megyn Kelly, and Candace Owens are all making the same mistake.

Team:The Supreme Court didn't rule on Louisiana v. Callais , but a decision from the so-called "shadow docket" holds some ominous warning signs for that case and the future of the Voting Rights Act (VRA).
The Supreme Court recently reversed a lower court order requiring the drawing of a "minority opportunity district" in New York state. The lower court had ruled that that type of district was likely required under the New York state Constitution.
" What's that kind of district ," you ask? Minority opportunity districts are electoral districts drawn during redistricting to ensure minority populations can elect candidates of their choice , often functioning as "majority-minority" districts. These districts help minorities overcome historical underrepresentation and are mandated by the Voting Rights Act to prevent the use of gerrymandering to dilute minority voting power.
Well, the opponents of voting rights on the Supreme Court didn't care about that. Conservative Justice Samuel Alito, writing for the majority in the sudden decision, said that that race conscious districting in state laws and state constitutions is “ unadorned ” and “ odious ” racial discrimination. Against white people, we assume he means.
This is most ominous for Section 2 of the VRA, which requires that racial minorities have an equal opportunity to meaningfully participate in the electoral process. This provision has been used to strike down redistricting schemes and maps that prevented Black voters and other racial minorities from electing their preferred representatives. Since 1965, Section 2 has given people of color a seat at the table, from school boards to the halls of Congress. It appears this 60-year era is coming to an end.
Team: We're fighting every day to preserve the values of the Voting Rights Act and protect our fundamental right to vote. Will you help fuel our work with $35 or whatever you can today and help us [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=041326_3&amount=35] to spread the word about these cases and the consequences of dismantling the VRA? “ Race is a part of redistricting always ,” Justice Sonia Sotomayor said, addressing the solicitor general from Louisiana, who was arguing against an existing map that had enabled the election of two Black members of Congress in his state. “ What you’re saying to us [is]...‘You can use [race] to help yourself achieve goals that reduce particular groups’ electoral participation, but you can’t use it to remedy that situation .’”
Striking down the last remnants of the Voting Rights Act is exactly why the Supreme Court held this case over from last year. Gutting Section 2 would take us backwards in time and allow racial gerrymandering to be a standard practice, silencing more voters. Just like the redistricting fights across the country, this is all about whether the party in power can choose their voters in order to stay in power in perpetuity.
Ari Berman at Mother Jones said it best after oral arguments: " The Supreme Court, with its six-to-three Republican-appointed majority, appears ready to kneecap what remains of the Voting Rights Act’s protections for minority political representation. "
The objective of these justices seems clear -- a complete dismantling of our seminal civil rights law . We've said it before and will say it again, but it's been clear long before the MAGA movement that Chief Justice Roberts has seen the removal of the VRA as one of his top goals for his time on the Court. It appears he may be on the cusp of succeeding, with the VRA no longer able to stop white majorities from locking racial minorities out of elected office through racial gerrymandering.

subject: NEW POLL: In a general election head-to-head, we are tied
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Saikat For Congress
body:
Movements win by building momentum faster than the establishment can stop it. | | |
---
| Hi team,

We just got the first poll since the debate — and our campaign is surging.

A couple months ago, we were 21 points behind in this race. Now, according to a reputable pollster, we’re just 5 points behind — 28% to 33% — and closing fast.

Even more importantly, we now have the highest favorability of any candidate in the race, which tells you something simple but powerful: when voters hear our message, they respond.

And because California has a top-two primary, this puts us in a strong position to make it to the general election — where, in a head-to-head matchup, we are already tied.

**But I want to be clear about something: I’m not planning to come in second.[](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMWn3R7U15hZOprFI75oZg44XG7BLR-DG8pEA_Wi6Q2_PdNrRlpHqVVZKU1ZKuXW-JY4cULZT6RPcIwqrwkKok-QAg2cGUu2rtRSDdGOzZZbIh2PmtZCPP1TjY2jVqb0s6ULPH3Y4nrfzoMor0llZ4rbOsSQQYhfJhrTqeaHRZ0_dHr3Dz8X5pyl0-cgn5M2WB0_YINjJFdmNRxu19Joz9wiR314o46Luwi3ZKpwHzQHzX_AADqgUQJtJcbRao_FnoN22ctl4gsgGYsDMcmPSQNYm4lhjATMFJ46_kR2FKeYWwoGOecXcNXbrfUNMlE229Q/4ps/Qek_PaS5RuuB-oY_uneLww/h0/h001.MXo5uQxBqGWPf-dVKP0b-uqaylj4yPdwLw8zIvqKN38)** We have a real chance to win this primary outright and completely shock the political establishment.

And our opponents can feel it.

That’s why, over the last few weeks, they’ve started sending out attack mailers, lying about my background and record, and even attacking me for reaching voters on Hasan Piker’s stream.

They’re panicking because they know what happens if we win.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

My parents, a tough Army General and an even tougher schoolteacher, gave me two choices: Go back to school, or get a job. So I went to work at a fine-dining establishment some of you may know as Waffle House. Simply put, I’ve had to work for everything I have ever had in life. Jesus carried me through trauma, heartbreak, single motherhood, public failure, and private grief. He carried me when I was diagnosed with PTSD. He carried me when I moved four times to keep my children safe. And when I had nothing left to give, He filled me with living water. Twenty-five years ago, I made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel. I got here the hard way. This isn’t about headlines. I’ve had a target on my back since I took on the establishment, but now they’re serious. They will stop at nothing to silence me. Dems are hurling MILLIONS against me, and establishment Republicans are throwing their support behind RINOs just to shut me down. The battle is just getting started. If you’d like to follow my journey on the campaign trail, will you sign your name below? subject: My grandfather picked cotton on land he'd never own

body:
And now, I’m carrying his legacy with me each and every single day.
| | | | | [](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001AbV-g6L0ALGl2M8F5lIqIcA9AZ6s_nI4cmzY_y0u9LGePwRFLCP5WTGN8cxoel3iqkMT3LBAiyRoIBZ7XhrIR_AwUbiAtETIozW6UJ4ZckjKq3sTFp5u0w3D66QbqCvZNEvcqe-7GRhK43GRRyn-4joMHMoHf5yeqXyqkaT4oeB_XG-M_yoKtmKSPz7hrQCRTPUBqL_asoaZiUde4E13fXt5EnvZTyHr6o5F8kA6OGo=&c=pezDhFgjluY39Ymp1PyAj4mbJJK0HcaDO9ESR-3-t2GIzuqQkny1rQ==&ch=MgpX98U00lMyjciIuX795g3ZDsr86Ox88fYHeVjYVlJymamX7yIa3g==)

| Peter,
My grandfather was a sharecropper.
He worked the land from sunup to sundown that he would never own. He picked cotton by hand in the brutal Louisiana heat, breaking his body for a system designed to keep him exactly where he was -- poor, powerless, and dependent on the landowners who controlled everything.
That was life in the Louisiana Delta. My father grew up in that world. In those days in rural Louisiana, many boys left school early because their families needed them in the fields.
Work came first.
But my Dad had a dream that his son wouldn't have to live that way. That somehow, some way, our family would own land instead of working someone else's. That we'd build something that couldn't be taken away.
And he did it. Through decades of backbreaking work, he made that dream real.
We started with 220 acres my father had leased and built it into something real, something ours.
Today, we farm over 3,200 acres. 700 of those acres belong to my family outright.
Some of the same Louisiana delta soil my grandfather worked as a sharecropper -- my family owns it now.
Do you understand how profound that is? How impossible that would have seemed to my grandfather?
And now I'm running to become Louisiana's first Black senator since Reconstruction.
Sometimes I think about what my grandfather would say if he could see this moment. A man living in a system designed to keep him down, whose grandson might represent this entire state in the United States Senate.
It takes my breath away.
This isn't just about me. It's about every Black family in America that was told they'd never amount to anything. Every sharecropper's descendant who was supposed to stay in their place. Every person who was counted out before they even got started.
If I win this seat, it won't erase the centuries of injustice that came before. It won't undo what was done to my grandfather or the millions like him.
But it will prove something powerful: that in Louisiana -- in the Deep South -- we can move forward. That the grandson of a sharecropper can stand as an equal in the halls of power. That our democracy, for all its flaws, can still bend toward justice.
My grandfather never got to see this. My father -- God rest his soul -- never got to see this either.
But my grandkids will. And maybe, just maybe, they'll grow up in a Louisiana where anything truly is possible, regardless of the color of your skin or which side of the tracks you were born on.
That's what this campaign means to me. It's personal in a way I can barely put into words.
And I need your help to make it real.
[Will you chip in $50, $25, or even $10 before our End of Quarter deadline at 11:59 PM to help the grandson of a sharecropper become Louisiana's first Black senator since Reconstruction?](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001AbV-g6L0ALGl2M8F5lIqIcA9AZ6s_nI4cmzY_y0u9LGePwRFLCP5WTGN8cxoel3izQ2tPj8xvDgWlWg_I-gr9z8bhkTTEMLYpVqnWbJ0h1MBSQlb3LXoREnN81UXQlS4ZczsoD4H-pZgIn68cj3-ekEpPpAHxeoaZ143U7neQlBQsYocBteA-f9g2klbEafUs8YQZ6yzteCpwnxfrB2TgdGtC8sjgNqpEQJ3vfVxFbC9S7TlUHEMmw==&c=pezDhFgjluY39Ymp1PyAj4mbJJK0HcaDO9ESR-3-t2GIzuqQkny1rQ==&ch=MgpX98U00lMyjciIuX795g3ZDsr86Ox88fYHeVjYVlJymamX7yIa3g==)

# Tuesday, April 14, 2026
---|---
**Good Morning!** On this day in 1902, James Cash Penney Jr., along with two partners, opened the 25-foot by 40-foot "Golden Rule Store" in the mining town of Kemmerer, Wyoming. Historically, gold and equities tend to move in opposite directions. But when they rise - and even correct - together, it has often appeared during periods of underlying stress in the financial system. We saw similar patterns:
* **In 1999,** before the tech bubble correction
* **In 2007,** before the financial crisis

* Inflation remains persistent
* Energy markets are becoming more volatile
* Global tensions continue to rise
* Interest rates remain elevated
* National debt continues expanding

* Energy markets are becoming more volatile
* Global tensions continue to rise
* Interest rates remain elevated
* National debt continues expanding

## FBI Raids Spring Home Connected to Altman Attack
FBI agents [raided a Spring home](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGOpDAQRU8DmZFtPNAEDjYhm003RIVdhtIau-UyTc-efsVcYeIvPf33_nwun0CR0vYbDrT1HfKS8OKItWJZwkoFyG85_YOIXJBpSwzJL1rqQUgjlFk8UPxaTOvtKv2kWrRqHAc1mEHKdrdynFAb6L0Mo-sfH8OknFZmddIYlMa1ZG-YNMooJXv16CZY5aT08DC9C-pjaoxETzWXru5Y8Q0c4ld-YelcPtpo91qf3PS_Gj03er6uqwv5fVvce6Pnkxs9h5XE7cLimyD2fKDgk5_oqgDnTkYv6l7yRWkTR4655pdw2f2tQFEwHAJiPSCxYEgiFEiO2GWx55OxLdY_L4qReBgbI7cDKH7fqz-L-rL6fwAAAP__m6mPUQ) yesterday for evidence related to 20-year-old Daniel Moreno-Gama, the suspect accused of throwing a Molotov cocktail at OpenAI CEO Sam Altman's San Francisco home on Friday. No one was injured in Moreno-Gama's attack, and he was arrested hours later when he tried to break into OpenAI's office with the intent to [burn it down](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGO3CAYBOCnwR0r-I0BFxRp3F3alNYP_NjoWLMy5Hybp4-cV0g90mi--fWxfmAu-dh-4pNc_051PehqhXqnc00-n5jjVo8_WKid1PJ2NDziCgI0F4pLtUbM5b2qITov4iwHctIYLbXSQgy7Q29w9MF6m5SabbAB0EczRQ2TnicxZHeXCSWVlGKU9jGjF7MEbdUYkpxmpgTF3Ov56Dt1-saWyrt-0fkI9TkUt_f-amz8wWBhsFzX9fjc6-87ZLDg2XMoxGC5XQyWUgMWBkvymd843nfiV62x4BEbry86MHPsHcMngwXsxI3xNkSpuIKEXFkBHBMhD2RGSnr0gWA4XXxduZTctGFKbE_M5d_A_n-3fjn4GwAA__-EvYqa), according to investigators. He allegedly drove from Spring to San Francisco to kill Altman and other tech executives, motivated by anti-AI views outlined in a manifesto he was carrying. California prosecutors have charged Moreno-Gama with attempted murder, and the Justice Department [levied federal charges](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHSoyAURp9GOxxAAqGg2MYu227pXOWqzCI4cBOTffod8wp_f-bMd74_j_EBIYa0_oYdHb2XPCY8a0QiLOMyhQLBrzn9g4i1YA1rqpD8KLnUjCsm1OghxM-oWu8m7q1o0QljtNBKc95uDntjrDA3w-0EE1rLzaTALvYutDK9bYO7ZFwJJQTvxb2zMHErpL6rfl7EzTaKow-US0cbEr6hLvGTX1i6Oe9tdBvRUZv-VyOHRg7neXZLfku95WelnC6okcNV1chhmQK7kiqrRwlpZV8f2_KObM4p4UzoWX3WA2diUGpODIhg_ssq7Awi7ZAu_lmxLc4fZ4gxVG0axdcdQvxuop89-XLyfwAAAP__D1KKmA) yesterday for attempted damage and destruction of property by means of explosives and possession of an unregistered firearm. Moreno-Gama was the author of a Substack blog featuring several essays expressing concerns about artificial intelligence, and he was a member of an [anti-AI activist group](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpSAUQL8GOwwg4rOg2MZutt3SXOGiN4NggHnO26_fvP2FqU9ycnL-fKwfQJHS_htOtO075DXhXSO2hmUNGxUgv-f0FyLWgpX2VCH5VQlluNBc6tUDxdeqO2834WfZoZXTZKTRRojusGYAs00KwmQeQYbNG4FeuWEcw6RHN3Zk3zKhpZZSDPLRz7CJWSrz0IMLcpyZFuip5dK3Axt-Qw3xlZ9YepfPLtqjtauy4RdTC1PLfd-9O0pOb8rUsn1VSlgrUwuURi4iU8sJiYNzXxU9p8TPHHPLT-6y-2xAkUNr4D55DjxfmIC4UkpoNQ_9dVxdsf66KUaqZmJa7CdQ_N_SfnbwadW_AAAA__--7YY4) on Discord, which banned him from using its products on Monday.
## Austin Gun Store Employee Charged with Murder
An employee of an Austin gun store has reportedly been [charged with murder](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL_O3CAQxJ8Gd5wAc_5TUKRx96VNaa3NYq-C4QR757s8feTkEb5yZqSfZubX1_wFFCltP-FAx--Q54RnjciMZQ4LFSC_5fQHItaClbZUIfnZKNNJZaW2sweKn9k23i3Kj7pBp_u-053tlGp21-n-bgYdVBj6Zez71garvb3jYtEOo23IXTBltdVatXq4jbCoUZtusO0a9H0UVqEnzuXGOzK-oYb4yS8stzUfTXQ786OK9ocwkzDTeZ63329IVyjMdK0RZop5hSjMBM_KlISZtmeSlXNBmc-ERa4R6KgSj0fMH8QqYWX0kpKsGIP0GDBVvDRCZfmfI_d80Er-8l9YmTZgyhe-Kc4_ToqRatcLq7YDKP7ry997-eXM3wAAAP__R6uUJA) in a fatal shooting at a local bar on Friday night. Michael Cargill, owner of Central Texas Gun Works, claims the unidentified employee acted in self-defense. Several people injured in the melee sought care at local hospitals, according to police. Authorities have not provided information about the victim or suspect. During a Saturday press conference, Cargill claims two of his employees visiting the Cabana Club were mistaken for members of another group and got [involved in a fight](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOozAQhJ8GOiPbGBwKF9fQ5dor0QavwZKxI-8mJPf0p9z_v8HfjmZGM9-f63KFmGLefsOBjl-hLBlPSsiMdQm3WCH6reS_kJAqUtwyQfaLlnoU0ghlFg8xvRfTeneTflItOmXtqEYzStnuDryRPig7gentuqLxoHGyysBgBjv0bXSfMmmUUUr26tJNcJOT0uPF9GtQw9QYiT5yqR3vyPgCCuldnli7tRxtcjvznZr-V6PnRs_neXahvCw8iGP-WBo9fz41ev7SxPbIgrhUFOXMWMWaIB4k8Lin8kYkASujF4QpCI8BM6FAIBbfedpL4Zi3tjp_P2NKkUbbGLkdENP_UfwzlE-n_wUAAP__jF6L7A) that left one of them unconscious. The other employee "_made the decision to pull out his firearm and stop the threat_." "_My employee did exactly what I would have done and exactly what he's been trained to do_ ," [Cargill said](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL1u7CAUhJ8Gd6wAY3tdUNzG3d42pXWAg43CworD_uXpIyePkHpGo_m-j8t6gZhi3v7DFU17hbJmfFLC1rCuwcYK0W8lf0FCqkhxywTZr0qokQvNpV49xPRedeeNFX6WHRo5TaMc9ShEt5vBOjkFp9EGrQc5KzWg9zj05wGVU76L5hgTWmopRS_PpxmsmKUaz7p3QQ4z0wJ9bKWe2o4NX0AhvcsD68mVa5fM3tqNWP-PqYWpxVmCO7WYj5Sp5cBhaknFQWJqQaDGfwvc3ilmJELitMMnZg6hYeUBGiROeykt5o1nhModWMjAXbrbrhp_e8aUIo0T02K7Qkw_X9rfDD6M-g4AAP__qwaIMA). "_They defended themselves. They were being attacked. Someone tried to kill them_."
## El Paso Artist Hal Marcus Dies
Celebrated El Paso artist and musician Hal Marcus [passed away](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDuO5CAURVeDM0r8xp-AYBJnNemE1jM8bNTPUALaVe7Vt6q30PGVrs45_-_LHSLFtP2DA217hbwkfFbC1rAsYY0Fot9y-gLCWrDGLVVIflFC9VwYLs3iIdK1mM7bVfhJdmjlMPSyN70Q3W5XFdCD0857r0cpw6CxhzEgOB2CGbpo32fCSCOl0HK8TbCKSap-NNoF-WdiRqCPLZdb27HhC2qgK59Ybi4fHdm9tUdl-i9TM1PzR8ivdr4npua3C1MzZQfE1Lwi5RM9h9JibXwH4gcU91m5j1i5h6tyCA0Ld0i4FmgxbXwDIixX5Vq0nUNK8cRSoVxdsf7xjESx9gMzYjsg0g9U-13K06rvAAAA__-Naoxx) Sunday at the age of 74 following a battle with pancreatic cancer. Marcus is known for his pop-surrealist paintings of scenes in and around El Paso. For the past 30 years, he [operated a local gallery](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2OrDAQhE8DGcjdmB8HDl5CNi_dEDW4AUsNHtnWMLOnX7FX2KykT6pSfV-P6UFe_Ln9p4Ntfq9hOvlKwjlznNbZR_JuC-c3CafIyW9notNNqLCrlK5AT468fCZdOjsrZ6BkC33fQac7pcrd9q1eV7MOAyG3CIRgZtQzLmpozex06e1dpjRoANXAUBualQHsBt0sK7Sm0IqdzyHWeefMb0qrfMKLY72EoxS75_xMRfOvwLHA8bqu-kN7CDctcLzvFDhSzH4RvuPMEl7sKpbqSSlUN0q52kkqVKDBNNjUez6kjNY9Ly_iU9cXWm0HefkdzX9T9bL4EwAA__82GXza) where he sold his works along with those of other artists, many of whom he mentored. He was also a children's book illustrator and a drummer for two bands. "_He changed me in so many ways, always more and more true to who I was created to be_ ," said Luke Lowenfield, the author of several children's books. Last year, Lowenfield bought the artist's 9-by-11-foot painting _El Paso Gracias a Dios_ after federal officials [ordered its removal](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLuypCAURb8GMy1ARA0IJjHrSSe0jnDUU8XDAqZfX3-r-xdutqO9aq1_t_UG5CkefyGgqc89rREfxWOtmNd9owzkjhTf4LFkLHTEAtGtkkvdctUKtTog_1pV48zG3SwaNGIctdBKc96cZpik3gc3OBgn4TROG86bs_0O1qpZ24bM54wroYTgvZi6GTY-C6kn1dtdDDNTHB3VlLt6YsUnlN2_0h1zZ1NovDlrvQrr_zC5MLmgv6CkAB-B0qV8MLlILgcmFz58N5PLCb4NkO3_0l5AsVI82owh3dG1e06htScEeoNncmmycdeDvKeiR6b4EYD8F11_F-xu5E8AAAD__721f5M) from Chamizal National Memorial. San Antonio photographer Billy Calzada, who grew up in El Paso and used to rent from Marcus, called him "a treasure beyond measure." Ysella Fulton Slavin, whose mother cultivated the artist's talents when he was a freshman in high school, [said](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL1uhDAQhJ_GdEZes8C5cJGG7tKmROvzApYMPtnO_eTpI_IK6Wfm03xf1_lKIYZj_aSdbX0taT74WSLXynleXMgU_JqOH4pcMpewHoUOP2ulB6lQAs6eQnzP2HjrlDfQsIVxHGDAQalms9wb5w1ohwD9gEYjuIV6R51nd-mwCfYcUwgIoDq4tIacMqCHC3a3BXojULEPNeW2blz5RWWJ7_Tg3N7S3kS71XovovsQehJ64ninknY6D5Q25VXo6QQIPSkUegIt9LRRlDvl23eRHOVZkJRrKFX6wEWOZ7DJ1t-fIcZQhlGgWncK8Q9Z_yfqYfVvAAAA__-CgHrJ) Marcus "was always like a big brother to me."

---
| Friend,
We did something different in Wisconsin, and people are sitting up and taking notice. With a smaller budget than our Pennsylvania Supreme Court race in 2025, we couldn't run a full field and TV campaign. Traditional organizers. Mailers. Ads on every screen.
That wasn't in the cards.
So instead of doing less of what everyone else does, we did something no one else was doing.
Our co-founder Joe Bachman was just interviewed by Wisconsin Public Radio about the cutting-edge voter contact technology we deployed in the state and how it helped us punch way above our weight:
---
| [](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001BmlfTT-CfPaSo9JE4Nv0EB46Nof4dW8AcJLBJN1EDG6LdKdUaHF98WNPkGLB9X0vuB8rUsc44eAraXfTNttDKblm9vdFIglfWidJcy2_N2muqP0IfsF4DAsYoXmfLYHZwEozR5wQrhLYxE6Eu0YEr_jjhVAaPvpd03bA6aunpG33F8zkr1DZlthdgmp1EKmeraHMrYcN2Tsw1DxtDHhqtsuycVn0HE5Lt8U78DbTCo82OhNb5n3zY-KuCFi-yEtD&c=UbTXVqgtsdSphJsld5FgI9nn-Gmt705uxziNBKQXNw0dGOSshsapXQ==&ch=ajjR0n1uCuhjEwCm_6fIvIwVFF9f5-m98jExEQFTqQze2aHdRZtieQ==)
---
| Here's the core idea: every Democrat deserves an organizer in their pocket.
An actual, interactive tool built specifically to talk a voter through exactly what they needed to know. Where to vote, what ID to bring, how the process works. One that could speak to Chris Taylor's record and positions on the issues. One that could answer questions with accurate information, at any hour, at a massive scale: we used it to reach over 1 million voters.
We share the concerns about AI's energy demands, economic disruption, and impact on workers. That's why we worked with our partners at Convos to keep our footprint minimal. And for what it's worth: this approach has a smaller environmental impact than a large mailer campaign.
AI is becoming a bigger part of political campaigns. As we read stories about deepfakes and misinformation, Defend Our Courts is proud to lead the way in using this technology responsibly and transparently to have real conversations with the voters we need to reach. This also isn't about replacing the field organizers and volunteers who are the backbone of our democracy. It's about giving them a force multiplier. Reaching voters they couldn't reach. Having conversations that would otherwise never happen.
Wisconsin showed it can work and we couldn't have done it without you.
Tens of thousands of Democrats across the country pitched in to fuel this work. You made a difference in a race that far too few people were paying attention to.
Court races are like that. Under the radar. Underestimated. Until suddenly they're not. 2026 will have more high-stakes judicial races, with the same type of stakes as Wisconsin and Pennsylvania. We want to continue bringing our winning formula to key races on a national scale. But we need your continued support to do it:
[If you believe in what we're building and what we proved is possible, please consider chipping in $25, $15, or whatever you can spare today to help us build for more court battles in 2026?](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001BmlfTT-CfPaSo9JE4Nv0EB46Nof4dW8AcJLBJN1EDG6LdKdUaHF98WNPkGLB9X0vuB8rUsc44eAraXfTNttDKblm9vdFIglfWidJcy2_N2muqP0IfsF4DAsYoXmfLYHZwEozR5wQrhLYxE6Eu0YEr_jjhVAaPvpd03bA6aunpG33F8zkr1DZlthdgmp1EKmeraHMrYcN2Tsw1DxtDHhqtsuycVn0HE5Lt8U78DbTCo82OhNb5n3zY7xyMI-LMRlz&c=UbTXVqgtsdSphJsld5FgI9nn-Gmt705uxziNBKQXNw0dGOSshsapXQ==&ch=ajjR0n1uCuhjEwCm_6fIvIwVFF9f5-m98jExEQFTqQze2aHdRZtieQ==)

# Hopeful HHS Vaccine Reforms
|
---
|
---
| As we wait for the appeals, filed or in the works, to make their slow way through the courts following [Judge Brian Murphy’s preliminary injunction](https://xdzgmz.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyMDEyNjAsXCJsXCI6MTg0NzI2NDkzMTgzNjA4MjcwLFwiclwiOjE4NDcyNjUyNzQzMzI0NjA5OH0iLCJzIjoiNjE3NGE0NzdjNGE0NzQzMyJ9) last month in _American Academy of Pediatrics v. Kennedy_ , which **blocked HHS Secretary Kennedy’s authority** over key HHS and ACIP actions, Texans for Vaccine Choice wanted to update you on two important developments coming out of the federal government.
**First, Aaron Siri** , on behalf of the Informed Consent Action Network (ICAN), [has formally petitioned](https://xdzgmz.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyMDEyNjAsXCJsXCI6MTg0NzI2NDkzMTk5MzM2OTEyLFwiclwiOjE4NDcyNjUyNzQzMzI0NjA5OH0iLCJzIjoiZTdkYWJjMzdkYWMxN2IzYiJ9) Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. to **amend the Vaccine Injury Table** by adding approximately 300 additional vaccine-injury pairs to the National Vaccine Injury Compensation Program (VICP).
For context, Congress created the VICP to provide _fair and expedited compensation_ to those injured by vaccines routinely recommended for children and pregnant women. The Vaccine Injury Table lists injuries “associated with” covered vaccines, allowing eligible individuals to receive compensation without having to prove causation. The petition **asks HHS to finally include injuries long acknowledged** in Institute of Medicine reports and federal government or manufacturer documents but that have historically been omitted from the Table. **Next,** last week, HHS [renewed the ACIP charter](https://xdzgmz.clicks.mlsend.com/td/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyMDEyNjAsXCJsXCI6MTg0NzI2NDkzMjE3MTYyNzA4LFwiclwiOjE4NDcyNjUyNzQzMzI0NjA5OH0iLCJzIjoiNDQyOWE3MzNmYjhmZDU4ZiJ9), **expanding the required areas of expertise and placing greater emphasis on vaccine safety**. The new charter calls for a broader “balance of specialty areas,” which substantially widens the pool of qualified candidates and could enable Secretary Kennedy to **reconstitute the committee** without directly challenging Judge Murphy’s ruling that disbanded its current members. **Stay tuned and keep reading our emails for the latest updates and ways you can take action!**

Kennedy Jr. to amend the Vaccine Injury Table by adding approximately 300 additional vaccine-injury pairs to the National Vaccine Injury Compensation Program (VICP). For context, Congress created the VICP to provide fair and expedited compensation to those injured by vaccines routinely recommended for children and pregnant women. The Vaccine Injury Table lists injuries “associated with” covered vaccines, allowing eligible individuals to receive compensation without having to prove causation. The petition asks HHS to finally include injuries long acknowledged in Institute of Medicine reports and federal government or manufacturer documents but that have historically been omitted from the Table. name: Justin Story
subject: FL-9 Congressional Candidate Justin Story Calls for Immediate Free Elections in Venezuela
body:
"We took Ali Baba, but left his 40 thieves." \- Justin Story

| | | | | [|
---](https://votejustinstory.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=aa75fb334e8c06de90a8e46d5&id=97b7cd56fd&e=90ad5fc3c5)
| | | | | |
**PRESS RELEASE**

**FL-9 Congressional Candidate Justin Story Calls for Immediate Free Elections in Venezuela, Condemns Ongoing Repression Under Acting President Delcy Rodriguez**
_**“We took Ali Baba, but left his 40 thieves.” - Justin Story**_
---
|
---
| | April 14, 2026Contact: [Justin@VoteJustinStory.com](mailto:justin@votejustinstory.com?subject=&body=)
---
| |

**ST. CLOUD, FL** — Justin Story, Republican candidate for Florida’s 9th Congressional District, today demanded the immediate restoration of free and fair elections in Venezuela and sharply condemned the communist regime now headed by Acting President Delcy Rodríguez for consolidating power and continuing to oppress the Venezuelan people. “As the husband of Maria, a Venezuelan refugee who fled the brutality of the Maduro regime, I have seen firsthand the human cost of socialism and authoritarian rule,” said Story. “The Venezuelan people have suffered long enough. The time for playing games with this Communist Regime is over. Free elections must be held now — not after Delcy Rodríguez finishes consolidating power with her own hand-picked appointees while she waits out the current U.S. administration.” Story emphasized America’s stake in the outcome: “The American people deserve not to have a communist regime in their backyard. We must honor the high-stakes, high-reward military operation that removed Maduro by delivering a permanent solution. We took Ali Baba, but left his 40 thieves.” Story highlighted the regime’s persistent human rights abuses: “Random police searches and extortionate ransoms continue to terrorize ordinary citizens on a daily basis. Peaceful protests are still not free — they are met with force and suppression. Hundreds of political prisoners remain locked away simply for daring to speak out or oppose the regime. This is not a ‘new political moment’ — it is the same tyranny with a new figurehead.” He added a strong warning for potential travelers: “With American Airlines set to resume direct flights from Miami to Caracas as soon as April 30, tourists and visitors risk walking straight into a trap. The regime’s culture of random searches, kidnappings, and ransom demands makes Venezuela extremely dangerous for anyone entering the country.” Story declared that the regime’s leaders must face full accountability: “The regime deserves Nuremberg-style trials for their Crimes against Humanity, not acceptance and legitimacy granted for mere political expediency. It is time to rip the bandaid off and get on with it. If we fail to do so, we will once again face mass migrations from Venezuela in just a few short years.” Story also strongly condemned Rodríguez’s reported request to the National Assembly to expropriate the property of Venezuelans who fled the country. “Most of these exiles cannot safely return home without facing arrest or imprisonment simply for the act of leaving. To now seize their hard-earned property is an outrageous act of theft that further punishes the victims of this failed socialist experiment. I condemn this move in the strongest possible terms.” Story urged the United States and the international community to apply maximum pressure for transparent, internationally monitored elections without further delay, the full release of all remaining political prisoners, and the immediate restoration of freedoms of speech, assembly, and property rights. “The Venezuelan people deserve a real choice in free elections — not another chapter of authoritarian rule dressed up as a transition,” Story concluded. “As a candidate for Congress representing a district with a large Venezuelan-American community, I will fight in Washington to ensure U.S. policy prioritizes genuine free elections and human rights in Venezuela, not political expediency or waiting games.”To learn more about Justin Story, visit [https://votejustinstory.com](https://votejustinstory.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=aa75fb334e8c06de90a8e46d5&id=18b9e7a640&e=90ad5fc3c5 "https://votejustinstory.com")

While we were focused on winning Wisconsin, a coalition of pro-democracy groups has been building a full-scale campaign to win two seats on the Georgia Supreme Court.
That program is already firing on all cylinders. But there's a problem: They're facing a critical funding gap.
If that gap isn't closed immediately, the program could start stalling--or worse--breakdown altogether at the exact moment it needs to be strongest.
That's why they reached out to us. And it's why we're coming to you, Peter.
We've proven what works. We've proven we can win. Now we need to step in and make sure Georgia doesn't slip away. Because here's the reality:
Democrats are on a hot streak and we need fuel to keep the fire burning.
Georgia's judicial elections are nonpartisan and held during primaries. That means many Democratic voters won't know which candidates to support, unless we tell them.
And that confusion? That's exactly what MAGA is counting on. If we don't act, they win by default. If we step up, we extend our winning streak to 3-0:

### Democratic lawmakers -- and perhaps a few Republicans -- are eyeing LD299 as a $200M package of corporate handouts for the organics industry and other niche ag interests.
Apr 14
---

---

A $200 million raid on Maine's Budget Stabilization Fund is picking up speed in Augusta under the guise of economic assistance for organic farm businesses.
The so-called "Agriculture Bond" failed to clear the two-thirds threshold it needed despite gratuitous lobbying the the state government itself.
State House sources tell _The Robinson Report_ that the back-up plan for the same bipartisan interests who pushed the original Ag Bond are now pivoting to [LD 299](https://substack.com/redirect/bfaee5e4-e2be-4a97-abd9-9d7c457442d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- a concept draft original introduced by two agricultural business owners who now stand to benefit from the spending.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3cdff5f2-3b29-4038-885a-16732296f94a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Instead of borrowing, which requires a supermajority, they're going to spend directly out of the state's emergency savings account, which only takes a bare majority.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..W_JjHaN9GlBoWauobUHCYcunmjmHKgbhCh_zEQ7-NLc?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=194180517)
Republicans don't have the numbers to stop LD 299 from stopping -- but it's not clear they even want to.
The entire process is obscured -- as if intentionally -- by the use of a concept draft and an amendment that pipes money into a state agency, so the ultimate recipients of the $200M are not explicitly named.
The bill was introduced by a left-wing "organic" business owner in the House who would directly benefit from the bill's passage. In the Senate, the bill is backed by other business owners who also stand to gain.
State Rep. William D. Pluecker, an unenrolled from Warren, lists on his financial disclosures a job as the "Public Organizer" for the Maine Organic Farmers and Growers Accociation (sic) or MOFGA, the industry trade group likely to designate the winners and losers under the farmer welfare package.
According to public Form 990s, MOFGA received almost $1 million in taxpayer funding [in 2024](https://substack.com/redirect/811ce66f-e635-4e76-b564-2a2357fd90c2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
The money from LD 299 would flow from the Budget Stabilization Fund to the Department of Agriculture, Conservation, and Forestry (DACF) and into one of myriad funds that trickle down to a select group of farms and some NGOs.
[Share The Robinson Report](https://substack..RpG_eL8Rfq4jcTLbFTiKttXDOqQ2C85NoePG_t4hZO4?)
The funding mechanism is the same that was used to pull money for $300 checks to non-citizens and non-working households, which also drew down the Rainy Day Fund.
Same principle, different beneficiaries.
LD 299 is not on the calendar yet, but since it's sitting as unfinished business on the Senate calendar, it could come up at anytime.
Keep an eye on the Republican Senators, who are keen to let this fly under the gavel while "boys in girls sports" attracts the attention in committee rather than recording a roll call vote on it.

name: Kirk Cameron
subject: Fight Back Against Hollywood's Agenda with Iggy and Mr. Kirk
body:
Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love.

| | | You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friend in Faith,Please – for the sake of all our families – take it from me as someone who’s lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life... You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with “entertainment” that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace.But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue’s Clues_...
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zkjdberq5fkdflut0r57dqg27pia4fpihdsciajg_rp22sh2s8i6epr3chge6o30c3h2bs)
---
| | Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say... ...and they try to “educate” YOU about your “old-fashioned” and “mean” ideas.Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. **[Today, I’m inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children’s television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z64s9hjuf42o3abmiogf74gj4m2k1l635lpu23f0_rp22sh2s8i6epr3chge6o30c3h2bs)** Introducing: _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.I’m making this ground-breaking live-action television show with the great folks at **Brave Books**.If you’ve seen me and **Brave Books** on _Fox News_ , you know we’ve already countered those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” the Left has been pushing on children in our taxpayer funded libraries. Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic “Story Hours” of our own.And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries.It’s encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we’re working to have that same impact in television.
---
>> Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth.Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. >> Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart.>> Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. Because we can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a **Founding Supporter**.
---
The great news is that we’ve already completed and released the first ten character-building episodes of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_! We premiered it recently to a small group of children and parents and I wish you could have seen the smiles on those innocent little faces.And I wish you could have experienced _the parents_ watching their children absorb the beautiful Gospel messages.It was quite a moment for everyone – including folks just like you – who worked so hard to get us that far. But now **Brave Books** has an urgent two-fold problem that I hope you can help with.
---
_**#1. Brave Books needs to launch a massive advertising blitz to get around the groomers on the Left.**_
---
You see, we’ve made the first five episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ available absolutely FREE. That’s the best way we can reach MILLIONS of families with our Gospel-inspired messaging.But no one will see it if we can’t get the word out. And the Left will try to bury _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ at every turn. The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 – and with the recent launch, we need to raise the funds immediately.
---
_**#2. We must complete Season 2 to keep our momentum going and that cost is $250,000 for post production.**_
---
I know that’s a lot of money but it’s actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio. And obviously, we won’t work through Hollywood.Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children.We parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens must take over to rebuild a thriving, healthy, GOOD and GODLY culture. **[That’s why I’m asking you to please contribute $35, $50, $250, $500, $2,500 or more to help us reach our fundraising goal of $250,000 for advertising and $250,000 for Season 2.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zhf61hhnnrnnt0st62dkbp5v0lq2uopbicu69iho_rp22sh2s8i6epr3chge6o30c3h2bs) ** As our special “Thank You” for becoming a **Founding Supporter** at the $50 level, we’ll send you all ten episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ FREE on DVD.This exclusive _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ DVD is only offered to **Founding Supporters**. It won’t be available for sale anywhere. So with **[**your gift of $50**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4tit297sqcbdr76ob7gvivq940k3p9ssgja0rs0_rp22sh2s8i6epr3chge6o30c3h2bs)** , you’ll be part of a small select group of people who own our wholesome TV show on DVD. You’ll have it ready to watch with the children in your life. Or you can drop your DVD by your local school, church, mission, or even leave it in the waiting room at your doctor’s office. So many children have no way of hearing God’s message in their lives. Your random act of kindness may change a child’s life. **[So please – whether you can send $50, $5,000, $25,000, or anything higher or lower, please respond quickly and know that gifts of EVERY size are needed and greatly appreciated.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2lu617q9ug2s92los1l00h91sihquecn9hsaqp0_rp22sh2s8i6epr3chge6o30c3h2bs)** There’s no time to waste. Hollywood groomers have destroyed America’s Godly culture. But today we rebuild from the ashes.And it starts by ensuring the most innocent among us are filled with faith and family – not filth.Thank you for being a part of history by becoming a **Founding Supporter** of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.
---
Sincerely,
---

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The other night, **President Trump** shared an AI generated meme from Nick Adams on Truth Social that has caused quite the stir. The meme was a picture of **President Trump** laying his hand on a sick person in a hospital bed while being robed like Jesus. The caption to the meme that Nick Adams shared was "_Trump is bringing healing to America_." This meme and caption, **President Trump** reshared and then controversy ensued... Many have claimed that Trump thinks he is God because of this. **President Trump** took down the meme on Truth Social, which was the correct move because the meme was not necessary and explained that he saw it as him being portrayed as doctor bringing about healing. However, I can personally attest to the fact that **Donald Trump** does not think of himself as God. I have been around him enough to know this first-hand. In fact, I shared a story on social media about what President Trump whenever he invites guests into the Oval Office. View it here: [https://x.com/JacksonLahmeyer/status/2043757479889182844?s=20](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=28851665.14550.1.3319108a61e294907519f498df0a4c88) I am grateful that **POTUS** took down the unnecessary meme but would caution everyone on social media not to jump to conclusions so quickly. Keep praying for **President Trump** and his team that God will continue to pour out His blessing on America. Thank you, Pastor Jackson Lahmeyer

| | Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud.

He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus.

He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness.

And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible.

I saw it up close -- _Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. _

But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything.

_**He started observing the Sabbath. **_

Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance.

name: Doug Lloyd for MI Attorney General
subject: What Sets Us Apart
body:
Prosecutor first. Politics never.
| | |
---

| | Friends,

As we head into the general election, I want to take a moment to clearly explain what sets me apart in this race and why it matters for the future of Michigan.
This Sunday, April 19, Democrats will endorse either Oakland County Prosecutor Karen McDonald or Washtenaw County Prosecutor Eli Savit. While they come from different backgrounds, they share a similar approach to the role of Attorney General.
Both first became prosecutors after being elected in 2020. Both have aligned themselves with the agenda of the current Attorney General, an approach that has too often prioritized politics over public safety and used taxpayer dollars on politically driven cases. And both have demonstrated a willingness to act as political advocates rather than impartial prosecutors.
My path has been very different.
I began my career as an Assistant Prosecutor in 1996 and was elected Eaton County Prosecutor in 2013. I did not enter this profession through politics. I worked my way up, case by case, earning the trust of my colleagues and the people I serve. My focus has always been on applying the law fairly and doing the job the right way.
Eli Savit has built a reputation as a far-left activist. Early in his tenure, he issued policies declining to prosecute certain offenses, including prostitution, minor drug crimes, and some felony gun cases. Prior to taking office, he served as Senior Legal Counsel to the Mayor of Detroit. His record reflects a philosophy of selectively enforcing the law.
Karen McDonald has built her career with a clear focus on political advancement. While she has experience as a prosecutor, private practice attorney, and circuit court judge, her path has consistently aligned with positioning herself for higher office rather than a sustained commitment to impartial prosecution.
Her tenure as prosecutor has included controversial and highly debated decisions, most notably in the Oxford High School shooting case involving charges against the shooter's parents.
While some viewed those charges as groundbreaking, others raised serious concerns about the legal theory and its broader implications. At the same time, questions have been raised about the ethics surrounding the handling of the case, including the level of media access granted during an ongoing prosecution and whether the pursuit of national attention overshadowed the responsibility to handle the case with the utmost care and focus on the victims and their families.
Despite their differences, both candidates have made it clear they intend to continue the same approach we have seen from the current administration.
I offer a clear alternative.
I entered this race to restore focus to what the Attorney General's office is supposed to be: a place where the law is applied fairly, consistently, and without political influence.
As Attorney General, I will make decisions based on the law and the facts, not politics. I will ensure taxpayer dollars are used responsibly. And I will work every day to deliver equal justice under the law for all Michiganders.
When you ask what sets me apart, the answer is simple:
I am a prosecutor, not a political activist.
Thank you for your continued support. Now let's get to work.
Doug Lloyd Eaton County Prosecuting Attorney Candidate for Michigan Attorney General

Her tenure as prosecutor has included controversial and highly debated decisions, most notably in the Oxford High School shooting case involving charges against the shooter's parents. While some viewed those charges as groundbreaking, others raised serious concerns about the legal theory and its broader implications. At the same time, questions have been raised about the ethics surrounding the handling of the case, including the level of media access granted during an ongoing prosecution and whether the pursuit of national attention overshadowed the responsibility to handle the case with the utmost care and focus on the victims and their families. Despite their differences, both candidates have made it clear they intend to continue the same approach we have seen from the current administration. I offer a clear alternative. I entered this race to restore focus to what the Attorney General's office is supposed to be: a place where the law is applied fairly, consistently, and without political influence. As Attorney General, I will make decisions based on the law and the facts, not politics. I will ensure taxpayer dollars are used responsibly. And I will work every day to deliver equal justice under the law for all Michiganders. When you ask what sets me apart, the answer is simple: I am a prosecutor, not a political activist. Thank you for your continued support. Now let's get to work. Peter, it’s Governor Wes Moore.
During the legislative session, public officials like me have been barred from fundraising entirely. My team and I have spent the last few months focused on securing wins for Maryland, while staying on the sidelines of our reelection fundraising effort.
**Today, we’re back in the game.** We can once again build up resources to fight for our mission for Maryland’s future -- and it’s more urgent than ever.
**[So I’m asking for your donation today. We’re setting a $10,000 goal to hit the ground running and make up our fundraising gap from the last few months. Can you chip in any amount toward closing that gap?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260414-1.eFxlpt&refcode=em-20260414-1&t=2&akid=1274%2E1086043%2El08jkD)**

Here’s why this is so important: **We can only fundraise about 75% of the year, while my opponents can fundraise 100% of the time.** During the freeze, Republicans could spend their time raising money, meeting with Trump’s advisors, and collecting checks from special-interest donors who want to flip this seat.

clean_body: | | | Peter, We emailed you last week after Trump issued a chilling threat to wipe out “an entire civilization” of 90 million people in Iran. Now, Congress is back in session after a two-week recess, and the situation is still far from clear. While there’s a temporary ceasefire in place, Trump warned recently that if a deal isn’t reached, it “won’t be pleasant”1 — signaling more violence could be imminent. But Congress can still intervene, Peter. They can pass a War Powers Resolution to end U.S. involvement in the war on Iran. They can cut off funding for further military action. And they can move to hold Trump and his entire corrupt administration accountable. In solidarity, always, Working Families Party Source: 1\. , X, April 13, 2026. \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Team WFP Date: April 8, 2026 Subject: Congress must immediately return to DC to stop this illegal war Peter, We are in unprecedented waters. Yesterday morning, Donald Trump threatened to wipe out “a whole civilization” of 90 million people. And though a tentative ceasefire appears to have been reached in the time since, we can’t let Trump’s genocidal threats be ignored. He must step down or be removed from office. Congress MUST immediately return to DC to stop this illegal war and take the reins away from this bloodthirsty tyrant. Trump’s threats cannot be overlooked. And his calls for violence cannot be normalized. After he launched this illegal war, it only took him a few hours to bomb a school and slaughter more than 100 young girls.1 And in the weeks since, there have been more than 23,000 Iranian casualties, the vast majority of whom are civilians.2 All to fight a war that nobody wants. A war that nobody voted for. A war that has already cost U.S. taxpayers $44 billion. A war that is happening solely at the behest of tyrants like Trump, Netanyahu, and their corrupt, billionaire friends. We need to put an end to this. We need to do all that we can to bring about an end to this war — and hold those in charge responsible. body:

## Hello Peter,
---
Families are the backbone of our country and right now, Congress has an opportunity to strengthen policies that directly support moms, children, and working households.
As lawmakers consider the next phase of tax policy, we’re asking them to take the next step for families by improving the Child Tax Credit (CTC) and childcare support.
👉 Take 30 seconds to contact your Member of Congress: [** _CLICK HERE_**](https://mc4s5.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsDg0irXZSgdATNt61kLNh/dk_fxw-nzjgV)

Here’s what we’re asking for:

1. **Strengthen the Child Tax Credit for young families**
The Child Tax Credit recognizes that families are the foundation of our nation. Young families – who are early in their careers and facing the highest costs of raising children – should be prioritized.

2. **Reward work from the very first dollar earned** One of the best things about the CTC is that it encourages work. The more you work, the more you earn. That incentive should begin with the very first dollar – helping more parents enter and stay in the workforce.

3. **Make childcare support work for all families** Families – not the government – should decide how to balance work and raising children. Any family with earned income and childcare expenses should be able to access the Child and Dependent Care Credit, including those with one working parent and one caregiving parent.

⸻

Congress needs to hear directly from moms like you.👉 [**_Click here to contact your Representative now_**](https://mc4s5.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsE8LR3xxomYKjRiTqj55l/sdlPHkwjWSEO)
It only takes a minute – but it can make a real difference for families across the country.

Simply click on the USE THIS PDF or DOC LETTER button, download the file, and then copy and paste the information directly into your email to your Representative..

| | Peter,

I see how much work there is to be done in the state, and how much farther we need to go before we have ensured the security and well-being for future generations of North Dakotans.
I was a state legislator for District 7 from 2012-2022. I thought I was done, but I can’t just sit here - especially when I know I can do so much more!
**My plan is straightforward** : When I am re-elected, I have bill drafts ready to go that will provide much greater accountability and transparency of where our tax dollars really go. I will continue to protect your free speech, your 2nd Amendment right, and your private property rights. I will never stop trying to reign in needless and wasteful spending.

---
[|
---](https://endpropertytax.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d6930e918a0489c6f7d6bb50&id=06b26c2ab6&e=d842fb25cc)
| |
**Help me ensure that North Dakota remains a place where our children and grandchildren will thrive and live happy, prosperous lives.

**[**Donate $26 >>>
Donate $69 >>>
Donate $123 >>>
Donate $300 >>>
Donate $500 >>>
Donate $1,000 >>>
Donate any amount to help get Rick back in the legislature >>>**](https://endpropertytax.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d6930e918a0489c6f7d6bb50&id=115c043981&e=d842fb25cc)

**I’ll be honest with you;** in the past I stuck to my principles.... **and** I openly held other elected officials accountable. Let me tell you, that is a **big** job, and it’s one that doesn’t make many friends. I will always do whatever is right, friends or no friends, but I now realize holding other legislators accountable **cannot** be my responsibility.
It is the voters’ responsibility to hold their own elected officials accountable. I will continue to be consistently steadfast in my principles, to work with other legislators to get good bills passed and bad bills killed, and to educate the public as to why a bill may be good or bad.But it will be up to **YOU** as to whether your elected official is held accountable for their votes.You must be engaged. It will take both of us.

[Can I count on your support?](https://endpropertytax.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9d6930e918a0489c6f7d6bb50&id=3c6c962258&e=d842fb25cc)

Hi friends —

I’ve been wanting to write this email for a while, because it’s about something I’m genuinely excited about.

**In early May, my team is ramping up field organizing across Rhode Island.** That means we’re going to start knocking doors — not just in Ward 3, not just in Providence, but across the entire state.

That’s a sentence I couldn’t have written a few years ago. But that’s what running for Lieutenant Governor means: this campaign now belongs to all of Rhode Island, and we have to show up for all of it.

I’m so proud of where we are, but I also want to be honest with you about what it takes to get there.

Statewide field organizing isn’t magic. It’s clipboards and printed lit and door hangers and the cars to get our team from one end of the state to the other. It’s a summer intern who helps coordinate volunteers in a town where we don’t yet have deep roots. It’s the behind-the-scenes infrastructure that makes showing up possible.

**[We’re setting a goal to raise another $5,000 by the end of this week to help us get our field operation off the ground. If you’re able to chip in — even $25, $50, or whatever you can — you’re directly helping us put people in motion this spring 📋🚙🏡.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqucTtwdhB9JCqTOmaNtHEtXiPNxmTn8VQdBe_5QNIMOhK477NmrmcT7d4xBqw5v_uk_crMHpNmr1RckY1h3yElshWpeYX42fYxbk6t4sDj-231F0drcbNU3bqpdJA7U8DWn-wq78rUY3U-9tCQKW04q-WwiJ3BjCG6-Bu3hUwxnV4-U6090iy70RPtJ38uizRzGkjf57yzSModDWS_txX5y8veixbeoLI56JOlVog5GGXdSQE-mCUFcu3MpPlFMPmBboHAakKM1jyqYahqCsWfXsybh5EuPR0wEZIhUInK9UTdJAYYbtykniEG5dMz_20oXZuyO927XmdzMvgZQw_VHVKKHA1fL5pJ4sqBEYPTp2w/4ps/0GYfj8oxSZiIkzstyju_bg/h0/h001.5HimbwsMMCoNB11Vc3yvAbJHNbvcxNXpcERw5CTkjUc)** If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | [ **DONATE $25** ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqucTtwdhB9JCqTOmaNtHEtXApFSpyJnj0HFEgwPULeK5sxu2y01wCC09eySyEP5Jfx3-dGlRzCNuyGDEiaEdmmf_Cy8ECG4Idgfok2zMadXZF2YcJtDQ8s00-3QCVpDUecXOMQlb4aS2qUn_2W7afYrx9mj_GxlPpPy_4LylwaNX0m5-SMrddqoAL6ORLEj0pm8TpSGbelNzeOLAAcDDkMXhbgSrTlkw6PP735Pxd0sAf8sHjTBUQ8Nl3i3neacPTcPmGO1c-6X1TtcMFH-rQCYIl54UwgYhWDraJHomv6tzgO-IR3OfclJPpVCZJnxXZVCJswGTkGPjpCHIR5fpobtjbq031N5_j4EKoEhbISJF3HXtlevEY-Lmxeqk6ox_Nk/4ps/0GYfj8oxSZiIkzstyju_bg/h1/h001.qKXDgnuHI6ZjFubxvxuAjnyx8WQ45lqia51FARCpbWw)

I’m so proud of where we are, but I also want to be honest with you about what it takes to get there. Statewide field organizing isn’t magic. It’s clipboards and printed lit and door hangers and the cars to get our team from one end of the state to the other. It’s a summer intern who helps coordinate volunteers in a town where we don’t yet have deep roots. It’s the behind-the-scenes infrastructure that makes showing up possible. That means traveling further, building new relationships, and meeting people who don’t yet know what this campaign is about. The only way to do that is to show up. And the only way to show up is to Thank you, truly, for being part of this next chapter. , I’m glad you’re here for it. With gratitude, Sue P.S. | | What turns a 12-year-old girl into someone willing to die as a suicide bomber? It's a question most of us never have to ask. But for our guest today, Işık Abla, it's not a hypothetical — it's her story. Born and raised in Istanbul, Turkey, Işık was drawn into the world of radical Islamism as a child. Through a process of slow, deliberate indoctrination, she was shaped to believe that killing Americans and Jews was not just acceptable — it was holy. A divine duty. A path to paradise. By the time she was a teenager, she had been trained in the ideology of hate, and she believed it with her whole heart. She was not a monster. She was a child who had been taught that monsters were heroes. But God had other plans. After coming to the United States, she discovered Christianity — and her life was completely changed. # American Values and Sharia Law — Can They Coexist?
---
| |
---
| | American Values and Sharia Law — Can They Coexist? The easy answer: no. American values we know. Liberty, individual rights, ownership, equality, self-governance, family, and the freedom to exercise one's faith as they choose. When we try to similarly define the values of Sharia law, it gets a bit more dicey. We won't paint Muslims with a broad brush. A few Muslim nations have more freedom and personal rights. In contrast, others keep their citizenry under the strong thumb of dictatorial rule. Just like Christians, some Muslims are devout, some are cultural, and others are deeply radicalized. There are growing communities, isolated by design, in the US, attempting to create "no-go" zones and Sharia courts. This latter group is the concern Americans should be focused on. How far has Sharia Law infiltrated America? Read the full blog by joining our free membership at Moms TownSquare.

body:
Moving Forward, Together
| | | | | | [ ](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KP6AZN7WPDPTMCGWGKNG963D_0)
---
| **Welcome to the Barlow for Wyoming Newsletter. Your hub for latest news, information and upcoming events.**
---
|
---
| | |
---
| MOVING FORWARD, TOGETHER
---
| Hi friends, It’s been a full stretch on the road lately, and Kelly and I are overwhelmed with gratitude. Every week, we’re reminded that this campaign is built one conversation at a time. Whether it’s over coffee, at a community event, or in someone’s living room, people across Wyoming are showing up with thoughtful questions, honest perspectives, and a real care for where our state is headed. To those who have hosted, welcomed us in, and helped bring people together, thank you. That kind of support makes this work possible and keeps us moving forward. I also want to thank Kelly for being there with me at so many events. She brings a steady presence to every stop. We’re grateful to be a team and for the time we get to spend with so many of you. The OnlyCo WyoPod podcast, created by Josh Law, is now live, and I appreciate the conversation and the opportunity to share more about our vision for Wyoming. If you haven’t listened yet, I hope you will and pass it along to others (linked below). Josh also created some shorter clips you can share from our social media pages. Thank you, Josh! As we look ahead, we’re keeping up the pace. More miles, more conversations, and more opportunities to listen and learn. And I’ll say this simply: campaigns like this run on people. If you’re in a position to contribute, we’d be grateful for your support, no matter the size. Each dollar helps us stay connected, reach more communities, and maintain momentum in ways that reflect Wyoming values. The link is below or on the website if you can help. Other ways to support our efforts include prayers, forwarding this newsletter to friends, posting a Barlow sign at your home or business, and registering to vote in the Republican Primary on August 18. We hope to see you out there soon, — Eric

| **On The Trail**
---
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| | | GILLETTE We are so appreciative to those who open up their hearts (and often, their homes) to host meet-and-greets or fundraisers along our path. This support makes a big difference in getting out our message. A great example is the wonderful fundraiser held in Gillette, hosted by our dear friends Jeff and Tracy Wasserburger and David and Julie Fall.
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | | SHERIDAN COUNTY We spent a beautiful day at the Big Goose Natural Area for the Sheridan County Land Trust Event. Kelly and I enjoyed touring the new welcome center and seeing the exhibits. A great night for a great cause!
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | | CAMPBELL, CROOK, PARK (VIRTUALLY) & WESTON COUNTIES With the help of technology, I was able to Zoom with high schoolers in Cody involved in the Youth for Justice League. Then Kelly and I enjoyed a few great stops and meet & greets recently—coffee at Remy’s in Upton, cookies & coffee at Isabell’s in Newcastle, some great food at Longhorn’s in Sundance, and finishing with the Gillette Community College Casino Night fundraiser, where I was the emcee.

Afterward, we headed over to the Boys & Girls Club of Douglas, where I had the honor of speaking as a guest. The night wrapped up with a fun 'dessert dash' at the fundraiser... definitely a highlight!

Twin Lakes-Elkhorn Crest by Robin Coen
Dear Peter,
What are you doing next Friday?
OLCV’s biggest event of the year is almost here, and we’d love for you to join us to celebrate big climate wins and the community making them happen at the Annual Celebration for the Environment.
Friday, April 24th, 2026
The Loft on 8th, Portland
Doors at 5:30 PM
This year, we’re celebrating major victories like the passage of 1.25% for Wildlife and gearing up for the work ahead.
Expect a fun, inspiring evening with:
* Delicious food
* Oregon wine and beer
* A welcoming community of environmental advocates
* A chance to win your choice of three incredible travel packages
* Inspiring remarks from climate champions * Congresswoman Andrea Salinas
* Washington County Commissioner Nafisa Fai

It’s going to be a meaningful ( and really fun ) night. I hope you’ll be there.
Get your tickets [https://event.auctria.com/9bac5df8-723f-4cab-b467-c43ae5d9b9df/aa6cd270-8751-11e9-a741-3fcfcb35cbb0]
Interested in sponsoring or hosting a table? Reach out to me, April Christenson, at april@olcv.org.
Thanks for being part of this movement. We can’t wait to celebrate with you!
Warmly,

name: Mel Tull
subject: Wittman’s hypocrisy is astounding
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY MEL TULL FOR CONGRESS
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/melltull4congress [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/melltull4congress]
Rob Wittman's hypocrisy on gerrymandering is astounding.
Virginia is putting redistricting in front of voters through a referendum. Let the people decide. That's how democracy should work.
But Wittman stayed silent when Texas, Mississippi, and North Carolina gerrymandered their maps without a vote. No referendum. No voter input. Just politicians picking their voters instead of voters picking their politicians.
Why the silence? Because Trump pushed Republicans to gerrymander for more seats — and Wittman fell in line.
Now that Virginia's referendum puts voters in control, suddenly Wittman has opinions about the process. But when Republican states rigged their maps to protect MAGA majorities, he said nothing.
I believe people should pick their politicians, not the other way around.
Virginia's referendum gives voters a voice in how our districts are drawn. That's the right approach — whether it helps Democrats or Republicans.
Wittman supports gerrymandering when it benefits his party and attacks when voters get a say over their maps. That tells you everything you need to know about whose interests he represents.
We need leaders who defend democracy even when it's not politically convenient for them personally. Leaders who believe in fair maps and voter choice. Leaders who won't stay silent when politicians rig the system.

body:

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129451038/614387278/1538324755?refcode=email-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NjA0NTU4OC0xZTM4LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0w44uWrGlLNKNJ8sLO69IPerX4c-mcyCe9JD6juXT_M=) Peter, this isn’t the news we wanted to share, but a major development just hit our race: **[Two of Tina’s GOP opponents have raised over $2 MILLION (each!!!) and are planning to drop big bucks on television ads that will roll out across Oregon in the coming days.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129451039/614387279/-6070544?amounts=5,15,25,50,100,250,500&refcode=email_041426_gopads&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NjA0NTU4OC0xZTM4LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0w44uWrGlLNKNJ8sLO69IPerX4c-mcyCe9JD6juXT_M=)** Peter, and this is only the beginning. subject: A Black man could never win a statewide Louisiana election

body:
Don’t tell me what’s “impossible” in Louisiana. My family worked this Delta land when they were slaves. Today my son and I farm the very same fields together - but now we own it.
| | | | | [](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001LQn5eY2P7NPmZp1aNPH_j4bcPPmY-R0uFvuz5TxMgU-z50te8MKV6ujkvkhh6X1Mbj_2FRC4zuBDYLyZ4GCJXE7xz1VH6K_U5TPVTGnWrpvTfhJPY7ER9XJx6_kKlFFelvD4H6jm8D9OBY8doLouUKH_FzcT4XbzHn-pAg8M8IJF5cjERX_nyQgQYXdVNqLZXINIDDJOR3NAkuHpWVNkwScTVRO23YkO7F76NPH4Zek=&c=bZqJit97xNyhtoexfJZCiqg40QvWF3i76petuznG0LcqpeUAseUlDA==&ch=KypQYqyvmELTk7VK3IzqofUymobh5iAnj24HQbTj5AU_AiFhWk2oXQ==)

| Peter,
Some folks around here still say a Black man can't win a statewide election in Louisiana. I hear it all the time.
We haven't had a black US Senator or statewide elected official since Reconstruction. But I'm a farmer. And I know what grows in this soil.
My family worked this Delta land when they were slaves and then sharecroppers. Today my son and I farm the very same fields together - but now we own it. So don't tell me what's "impossible" in Louisiana.
---
| [](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001LQn5eY2P7NPmZp1aNPH_j4bcPPmY-R0uFvuz5TxMgU-z50te8MKV6ujkvkhh6X1Mbj_2FRC4zuBDYLyZ4GCJXE7xz1VH6K_U5TPVTGnWrpvTfhJPY7ER9XJx6_kKlFFelvD4H6jm8D9OBY8doLouUKH_FzcT4XbzHn-pAg8M8IJF5cjERX_nyQgQYXdVNqLZXINIDDJOR3NAkuHpWVNkwQHGHChQrGEjNKikat10Yu8=&c=bZqJit97xNyhtoexfJZCiqg40QvWF3i76petuznG0LcqpeUAseUlDA==&ch=KypQYqyvmELTk7VK3IzqofUymobh5iAnj24HQbTj5AU_AiFhWk2oXQ==)
---
My son and I on our farm in 2021. The same soil our ancestors worked for free.
This state was built by Black hands. We cleared the land, built the levees, grew the crops, served in uniform, and helped write the laws that shaped this place.
And history proves something most people forget:
We've done this before. Right after the Civil War, Black leaders here in Louisiana were elected statewide. They expanded public education, protected civil rights, and even elected the first Black governor in American history. Not somewhere else. Right here.
So, when people say it can't happen now, what they're really saying is we shouldn't try. I don't accept that. And I know you don't either.
I'm Jamie Davis -- a farmer, a father, and the Democrat running for the U.S. Senate here in Louisiana-- I'm running to prove that working families, rural towns, and everyday Louisianans still matter.
[But campaigns like ours don't run on corporate checks. They run on people. If you believe Louisiana is ready to make history again, will you chip in $30 (or whatever you can) right now to help us reach more voters?](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001LQn5eY2P7NPmZp1aNPH_j4bcPPmY-R0uFvuz5TxMgU-z50te8MKV6ujkvkhh6X1M8dcYjXljmGWFDF0d1pBDl3MREWbr9Jp3LL2kxuMaVMTKU81GRk32vPJK_Wf14TZNq5IhRDUsErQyldMGYVYkYdFPShp9IrUO-CGQLFvQQFSv3eS723ZBGnJezCl5-5_yJ0HUV4QLAHewH48SnMbI9tc0Z0N-GlBuooXBeg99Ge4FYqgRVffnow==&c=bZqJit97xNyhtoexfJZCiqg40QvWF3i76petuznG0LcqpeUAseUlDA==&ch=KypQYqyvmELTk7VK3IzqofUymobh5iAnj24HQbTj5AU_AiFhWk2oXQ==)

subject: We don’t have to live like this
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
That world is so much closer than we think.
#
My prescription cost me about $27 yesterday. It really wasn’t that long ago that I didn’t have any health insurance at all.
I was a waitress that couldn’t afford health insurance, so I just went without. No one I knew that I worked with had health insurance either because they also couldn’t afford it.
I’m grateful that my prescription yesterday only cost $27, **but a couple of years ago maybe I wouldn't have even walked into the pharmacy.**
A couple of years ago, I would've been so scared about how much it would have cost. And I know there’s a lot of people who still live that today.
**We don’t have to live like this.**
I want us to live in a country where if we have to go to the doctor or when we show up to the pharmacist with a prescription, a pit of anxiety doesn’t ball up in our stomachs.
Because too often, we don’t know what the price is going to be, and we don’t know what we’re going to have to give up — or if we’ll have to choose between rent, groceries, and our medicine.
That world is so much closer than any of us think.
We need to get special interest money out of politics. We need to get the insurance industry — which lobbies both parties — out of politics.
[ We must out organize the oligarchy and corporate influence in Washington. Help us continue the fight for progress with a grassroots contribution today.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260414.32IAbY&refcode=em20260414-11173-P_FND_CTR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=11173%2E2526796%2EKWKac2)

Alexandria
