clean_body: Why this Memorial Day matters more than ever| | | Patriot, It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250th birthday. Patriot, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. Patriot, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you. The 2026 National Memorial Day Parade is a once-in-a-lifetime moment where we need to do all we can to honor our country and our veterans. Bigger crowds. More veterans. More young people learning what courage, service, and sacrifice really mean. Historically, AVC has been able to do this at a fraction of what other major public events cost to put on each year. In fact, the entire parade costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl Parade! That means that every dollar that's contributed by a generous American like you makes a difference for this important event. But I want to reiterate that American Veterans Center does not take ANY federal funding for this event. It is funded entirely by private citizens like you who want to honor those who have sacrificed so much for our country. | | Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the parade, but also supports great programs like: Record hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to today before we lose these stories forever. Hold our annual American Veterans Conference, which allows young cadets a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, Vietnam, and our modern wars. Produce veteran-focused T.V. documentaries and specials that remind Americans the price of our freedom. But of course, the National Memorial Day Parade is AVC's flagship event honoring America's veterans. And this year's parade will be the largest in their history of hosting the parade. If you've been looking for an opportunity to give back to those who have given so much for our freedom, this is one of the best possible ways you could do it. And for a special group of veterans, this might be one of the last chances we get. You see, with each year that goes by, we lose more and more of our World War II veterans, and for the few we have remaining, traveling to Washington, D.C., for the parade is difficult. | | | | | WWII veterans were a key part of the first parade when it was revived in 2005, as they have been every year since for the last 20 years. But this may be the last year we have the opportunity to have these brave men and women with us for the parade. This year is a rare moment when living witnesses to World War II and America 's 250**th birthday overlap. And no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you. On Memorial Day - not just this momentous year of military milestones, but every year - please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. Visit a local veterans' cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. I believe that while we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, we can always do a little more. Patriot, thank you for your support of America 's heroes. Sincerely, Gary Sinise Honarary Grand MarshalNational Memorial Day Parade P.S. Patriot, America is stepping into its 250th year, and this Memorial Day begins that national remembrance. Veterans across generations have given their lives to defend America and all she stands for. And for the Greatest Generation in particular, this may be the last time they're able to join us at this year's National Memorial Day Parade. There's no better send-off we can give them than to make sure they're present to honor their fallen brethren during America's 250th birthday. subject: Trump’s approval rating is cratering
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
This is a big opportunity for Democrats.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260414-1&t=1&akid=3370%2E587540%2EZ_Ol3d)
Peter, this is not the poll that Republicans wanted to see:
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260414_1_young.Uo4lzu&refcode=em20260414-3370&t=2&akid=3370%2E587540%2EZ_Ol3d)
In the latest survey, **Donald Trump’s approval cratered to 25%** , down from 38%, among 18- to 24-year-old voters. It’s clear: Young people are tired of Trump’s BS.
We have to face the facts. A lot of young people voted for Trump in 2024. But the truth is that most of them don’t like what they’re getting in exchange for that vote.
One young former Trump voter told the _Washington Post_ they felt betrayed. These voters did not think they were voting for a candidate who was going to drive up gas prices with foreign wars while ignoring Americans’ needs here at home. They didn’t vote for federal agents patrolling our streets and shooting U.S. citizens.
And now, they’re turning their backs on Trump in droves. That opens up a unique opportunity where Democrats can win these voters over in the midterm elections.
These polls are good news for Democrats. But we can’t expect to win these voters over with the same old status quo politicians who have failed to stop Trump and have spent decades making excuses instead of taking action when it mattered.
That’s why Leaders We Deserve is supporting a new generation of leaders — like Mayor Zohran Mamdani, Texas State Senator Molly Cook, Georgia Rep. Akbar Ali, and a wave of bold young candidates like Christian Menefee and Nabeela Syed.
With your continued support, we can continue to offer voters another choice. We can help young progressives run for office in races big and small in every state.

Thank you,
David

body:
[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/30?refcode=&t=1001&akid=2011%2E251025%2E-FBNeR ]Abdul for US Senate [ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/30?refcode=&t=1002&akid=2011%2E251025%2E-FBNeR ]Abdul for US Senate

As I walked out on stage during our campus rallies, 2Pac's "Changes"
played out of the speakers.

There’s a reason why I chose that song, and I want to share that with you.
It’s this part of the song that really resonated with me:

"And still I see no changes, can't a brother get a little peace? / It's
war on the streets and the war in the Middle East / Instead of war on
Poverty..."

Peter, 2Pac wrote
that in 1992. Over thirty years later, we're still dealing with the same
issues:

* An illegal war with Iran that has already wasted billions of taxpayer
dollars
* Poverty that continues to be overlooked by those in power
* Politicians who talk tough and deliver nothing

Those lyrics really speak to the contradiction we’re living in.

That in the richest country in the world, it shouldn’t be this hard to
afford healthcare, to feel safe in your community, or to believe your
government is working for you. It shouldn’t be this hard.

And the people blocking us from achieving real, positive change are the
same corporate-funded politicians who've been in power for decades — the
ones taking checks from the same corporate PACs, serving the same MAGA
billionaire donors, and delivering the same nothing.

That’s why I’m running — to pass Medicare for All, end illegal wars, and
build a government that actually works for working people. I just need
your help to get to the U.S. Senate.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260414-1-ak.pfPbD8&amount=10&refcode=em20260414-2010&t=1004&akid=2011%2E251025%2E-FBNeR ]Chip in whatever you can to fuel our campaign. Every dollar goes
directly to reaching voters across Michigan and making sure this movement
has the resources to win.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260414-1-ak.pfPbD8&amount=10&refcode=em20260414-2010&t=1023&akid=2011%2E251025%2E-FBNeR ]Donate $10 ››

I chose that song because it tells the truth. Now, we have to do something
about it.

Your friend in the fight,

Abdul

name: Gov. Andy Beshear
subject: I have a signed copy just for you
disclaimer_text: Paid for by In This Together PAC
body:
My first book, Go and Do Likewise: How We Heal a Broken Country, will be available to you on September 22nd
Peter,

Some of you may already know this, but I wanted to share something I am really excited about.

My first book, _Go and Do Likewise: How We Heal a Broken Country,_ comes out on September 22nd. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129460159/614417448/-2030583542?refcode=em26_260413_book_fndd_gq_act___AB_ettx&utm_campaign=em26_260413_book_fndd_gq_act___AB_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=e2b32d3a-3238-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTAzNjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTJiMzJkM2EtMzIzOC1mMTExLThlZjItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=0l6LMu36017GIYjE30k1mr1EoXrO3nLDH4h6qop4Ma0=) I am tired of Donald Trump and his allies hijacking faith and using it to justify cruel and dangerous policies.

This is a book about reclaiming faith as a force for good in public life, and it strongly rebukes those who use “faith” to judge, to hurt, to harm, and not to help.

I write about some of the toughest times I’ve governed through, like tornadoes and floods, and how I’ve seen the very best of people in the darkest moments. And I talk about how we can heal this divided—and seemingly broken—country that we love so much. I know we can.

These judges will rule on voting rights, civil rights, and whether an authoritarian agenda gets blocked or rubber-stamped. And once these loyalists are confirmed, there is no do-over. No re-vote. No way to undo the damage. It’s court capture in real time. Demand Justice PAC is on the front lines of this fight — exposing every nominee and their shocking records, and calling this process what it is: a coordinated effort to stack the judiciary with Trump’s political loyalists. But if we don’t build enough public and political pressure to stop these confirmations, they will move forward. Quietly. Procedurally. Permanently. subject: Our latest ad has an important message for Michiganders

body:
Unions made Michigan - and Michigan made me.

| |
---|---|---
| | | Forwarded this email? [Subscribe here](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oYWxleWZvcm1pLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.PhVZlmYNamtHd0nsbnnbt-9gY3-2Nk2mk0XckZIZEWk?) for more

# [Our latest ad has an important message for Michiganders](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=194186305&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTk0MTg2MzA1LCJpYXQiOjE3NzYxOTMzNzIsImV4cCI6MTc3ODc4NTM3MiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.-y4ZNU5LKIcVqgW3p_zgDKJBmCq5uPqrqFiiqEMfOi4)
### Unions made Michigan - and Michigan made me.
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---
| Apr 14
---
| [](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---

---
| | | [](https://substack..eLXUxbxEnl-CXJmAjkx8-ir-rN_aPqQ47HS-fP1xXdw?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/our-latest-ad-has-an-important-message?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

Hi friends,
Some good news to share! My team and I just launched a new social media ad, and I hope you'll take a minute to watch it:
[](https://substack.com/redirect/34dde25b-6725-4a8f-b02c-4427fe83a557?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I'm proud of this ad because it narrows in on a core truth about our state and this race: **Unions made Michigan - **_**and Michigan made me.**_
I was born and raised right here, and I've been surrounded by unions and the manufacturing industry my whole life.
From the shop floors to the shipping docks, from Auburn Hills to Grand Rapids, we're not just talking about a 9-to-5 job - we're talking about a way of life. About a career you can raise a family on. About pride in building something with your own two hands. About what it means to be from Michigan.
It hasn't always been easy. There have always been people, pundits, and politicians who have doubted us. But in Michigan, we don't walk away from challenges. _We rise to meet them._
**To the doubters, I say: Come see Michigan.** Come do what I did, and walk the floor with our skilled tradesworkers and the picket line with the Teamsters. Talk to the folks who never gave up on what hard work, determination, and people power can accomplish, who've trained the next generation with calloused hands and open hearts.
This is the Michigan way: Grease, grit, and hard work. It's who we are.
**Unlike Mike Rogers, this campaign is deeply personal for me. It 's a love letter to Michigan - my home, my heart, and the people I care about most.**
It's about the people who built this state and keep it running every day. It's about good-paying jobs, union jobs, the kind that support families and build communities.
It's about whether our government is going to keep pandering to Wall Street greed or finally start working for the people who actually built this country - folks like you and me.
**[And it's about whether Michigan is going to have a senator who actually knows this state, loves this state, and has spent her career fighting for the people in it.](https://substack.com/redirect/628786de-98be-49f9-be6c-eb5ef6e0addf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
That's what I'm offering in this race.
My grit. My fight. And my deep love for Michigan.
Because I know that's what really matters here.
Every time I travel across this state, I hear the same thing from folks: You're tired of the chaos. Tired of the cruelty. Tired of powerful people protecting each other and making life harder for everyone else.
You want leadership that is competent. Honest. Trustworthy. Leadership that cares about making life better for our neighbors.
That's the Michigan way. And that's the spirit behind this ad.
Republicans are spending big on their own ads because they know Michigan is a battleground. They know the polls show we're tied with Rogers. [They know this seat could help decide control of the Senate.](https://substack.com/redirect/628786de-98be-49f9-be6c-eb5ef6e0addf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**And they know that if we keep reaching Michiganders with our message, we** _**will**_**win this race.**
That's why I wanted to send you this directly. If you haven't watched it yet, I hope you will.
With grit, gratitude, and a whole lot of determination,
Haley
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2efb3bae-faaa-45f6-8b29-4b00be81153d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* * *

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/628786de-98be-49f9-be6c-eb5ef6e0addf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Eric Swalwell](https://link.email.joinrmv.) amid sexual assault allegations and an active investigation, who has also annouced he's resigning from Congress. Meanwhile debate over the Supreme Court continues after analysis showed [fewer rulings expanding civil rights](https://link.email.joinrmv.), fueling disputes over media framing of the court’s decisions.
This is your Mountain Minute for Tuesday, April 14, 2026.

**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[He Loved This City. Then It Nearly Killed Him.](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
Nico Francis had spent the early part of the evening on April 3 at the First Friday ArtWalk on Santa Fe, and with friends waiting on Colfax, he grabbed a Lime scooter just after 11:30 p.m. and took what he called the scenic route.
It was a night like dozens of others for the Ohio transplant, who moved to Denver in 2020 — a man who had long been something of a downtown defender, someone who pushed back every time a friend called the area dangerous.
“I love 16th street. I love downtown. I like just riding through there and seeing what’s going on — seeing all the people, seeing everything going on,” Francis said.
That comfort level would not survive the night.

* **Breakdowns in security and procedure:** Changes to credentialing, lack of proper badge verification, and informal ballot handling practices raised questions about safeguards meant to prevent errors or impersonation.
* **Ballot discrepancies prompt calls for investigation:** Reports of roughly 80 more ballots than credentialed delegates, along with improvised processes for alternates, have led to calls for a full, independent review to restore confidence.

| I wanted to reach out about a bill making its way through Congress that could make it harder for millions of Americans to vote.

The SAVE Act, pushed by Republicans, would force Americans to produce citizenship documents just to register to vote, creating new barriers that could block millions of eligible voters. Women who’ve changed their names after marriage would be especially harmed, often required to track down additional paperwork like marriage certificates or court orders just to prove their identity. These documents can be difficult, time-consuming, and costly to obtain, and many people simply don’t have them readily available.

This bill isn’t about protecting elections—it’s about restricting access to the ballot and making it harder for American citizens to exercise their fundamental right to vote.

I’ve fought for voting rights throughout my time in public service. I’m committed to protecting the freedom to vote for everyone — no matter their gender, race, or background but I can’t do it alone.

This year, we need to take back the House to protect our democracy from extreme GOP policies like this.

This fight starts right here in Michigan, where five competitive House races could determine the fate of the House majority. If we want to push back against this dangerous legislation and fight for free and fair elections, we need to act now.

I especially need your support now since a new opponent has entered the race against me, backed by DeVos' dark money and GOP megadonors who are going to be flooding West Michigan to take this seat back.

clean_body: This year, we need to take back the House to protect our democracy from extreme GOP policies like this. | = | I wanted to reach out about a bill making its way through Congress that could make it harder for millions of Americans to vote. The SAVE Act, pushed by Republicans, would force Americans to produce citizenship documents just to register to vote, creating new barriers that could block millions of eligible voters. Women who’ve changed their names after marriage would be especially harmed, often required to track down additional paperwork like marriage certificates or court orders just to prove their identity. These documents can be difficult, time-consuming, and costly to obtain, and many people simply don’t have them readily available. This bill isn’t about protecting elections—it’s about restricting access to the ballot and making it harder for American citizens to exercise their fundamental right to vote. I’ve fought for voting rights throughout my time in public service. I’m committed to protecting the freedom to vote for everyone — no matter their gender, race, or background but I can’t do it alone. This year, we need to take back the House to protect our democracy from extreme GOP policies like this. This fight starts right here in Michigan, where five competitive House races could determine the fate of the House majority. If we want to push back against this dangerous legislation and fight for free and fair elections, we need to act now. I especially need your support now since a new opponent has entered the race against me, backed by DeVos' dark money and GOP megadonors who are going to be flooding West Michigan to take this seat back. = | | | = | = | = | = | = With gratitude, Hillary Scholten * | | = Paid for by Scholten for Congress Scholten for Congress PO Box 6233 Grand Rapids, MI 49516 United States | = = If you would like to receive fewer emails, . Peter, I know a lot of the news lately can feel overwhelming, but I want to take a moment to provide some reasons to find hope today.
1. **All across the country, we’re seeing a clear shift in momentum.** From local races to statewide elections, Democrats are delivering decisive victories because voters aren’t buying what Republicans are selling. In communities big and small, the American people are electing leaders who are focused on real solutions: lowering costs, protecting our freedoms and investing in our future.
2. **Donald Trump is deeply unpopular.** Polling shows that he’s underwater with voters, and we recently saw some of the largest protests in U.S. history against this president. It’s no surprise: the American people are fed up with the chaos, division and distraction while their costs continue to rise.
3. **We have an opportunity to turn the page on this dark chapter by flipping the House blue this November.** Democrats can take back the House majority, put a stop to the lawlessness, hold this Administration accountable, and fight for the American people. This is our chance, Peter.

There’s a lot of noise out there, but something powerful is happening, and it’s worth holding onto that hope. **But it won’t be easy, Peter. Republicans are planning to spend _big_ to cling onto their majority.** Which is why we have to work every single day over these next months up until Election Day, and turn this hope into change. **[If you can, consider pitching in $5 or $10 before our upcoming mid-month deadline. body:
I wanted to check in and let you know where things stand
| Darby, Mandela Barnes’ Campaign Manager here: Election Day is going to be here before you know it, and while Team Barnes is building up our campaign each and every day, we need supporters like you to continue to help us prepare to win. **[If that’s all you need to hear to support Mandela’s campaign, you can chip in right now!](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mb-em-fr-apr26-mmfr.FkyFOx&amount=15&refcode=MB_EM_FR_041426_B2_MMFRMemo&t=2&akid=6045%2E196590%2E3EJntX)** To give you an inside look at our campaign, here’s our latest state of the race memo for you:
| **TO:** Interested Parties
**FROM:** Mandela Barnes for Governor
**MEMO:** The State of Wisconsin’s Toss-Up Governor’s Race Just last week, voters across Wisconsin came out to vote for our Supreme Court and numerous down-ballot races, the message was clear:
> **1._Wisconsin is ready to elect Democrats up and down the ballot**_
Wisconsin is a 50/50 state, but last week voters showed up in droves to not only elect Chris Taylor to the state Supreme Court, but also flip two mayoral seats blue in historically red areas. **The fact that we’re breaking through in places like Waukesha County proves one thing: If we put in the work early, change is coming.** [](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mb-em-fr-apr26-mmfr.FkyFOx&amount=15&refcode=MB_EM_FR_041426_B2_MMFRMemo&t=3&akid=6045%2E196590%2E3EJntX)
> **2._Tom Tiffany is already running scared**_

body:
# [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=240793%2E444211%2EHVIH_n)
**Beto is heading back out on the road _again_ this week**, to talk to Texans at college campuses and register them to vote in Harris County and College Station.
But what’s special about our work at Powered by People is that we don’t just leave a newly registered voter to fend for themselves in the most voter-suppressed state in America.
**A member of our organizing team personally sticks with them through Election Day and beyond** — making sure they have the information they need, helping them make a plan to vote, and following up so that registration turns into a vote.
That personal relationship building is what sets Powered by People apart from others in your inbox.
In 2024, we took a voter turnout rate for 18-29 year olds in our program from 37% to 79%. Now, we want to grow this program to reach even more voters. But staying on the road in a state as big as Texas — and holding these organizing events on the ground — takes real resources.
[**If we’re going to keep meeting people where they are and grow this program to have the biggest possible impact, we’ll need your help. Please donate $3 or any amount that is meaningful today.**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260414.qN2_RT&refcode=ema20260414-240793&t=3&akid=240793%2E444211%2EHVIH_n)

subject: Back in the game

# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=1279%2E1086043%2EdDp119)
It’s our first day back in the game, and it’s a big one.
Maryland is one of Republicans’ top targets in 2026. And here’s why they think they can win:
1. This seat has flipped parties between every governor for the last twenty years. I flipped it from a Republican — and now Donald Trump’s allies want to flip it right back.
2. Our fundraising was on pause for the three month long legislative session.

Peter, you can bet every Republican mega-donor and strategist was behind the scenes building a war chest to defeat our movement.
Now that we’re back in the game, we need to raise the resources to stay competitive. Not with big checks, but with a movement of thousands of people stepping up together.
**[If you can, will you step up and give $10 or $20 today? Your grassroots contribution will help set the pace for the rest of our reelection campaign.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260414-2.teloJS&refcode=em-20260414-2&t=2&akid=1279%2E1086043%2EdDp119)**

# DNC Coalitions Newsletter
---
|
---
| **UPCOMING EVENTS**
---
|
---
| Join the Democratic National Committee and the New Jersey Democratic State Committee for “Know Your Rights” session. Voting is fundamental to our democracy and protecting that right takes all of us. In this session, you’ll learn your rights at the polls, what’s being done to ensure free and fair elections, and the legal protections and resources available to voters and business owners.
---
| [RSVP HERE](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=4ea3a1344e&e=d6c5c7d7ec "RSVP HERE")

---
|
---
| **ELECTION UPDATES**
* _**Florida **_
* Emily Gregory**[flipped](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=04eae0d456&e=d6c5c7d7ec) **State House District 87 (a Democratic win in Trump’s home district!)
* Brian Nathan**[flipped](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=376a95a42c&e=d6c5c7d7ec) **Senate District 14 against a Republican state representative.
* Andy Thompson**[flipped](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=cc044f8483&e=d6c5c7d7ec) **Boca Raton mayoral seat (first time Democratic-aligned candidate has won in 30 years)
* _**New Hampshire**_
* Bobbi Boudman**[flipped](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=1edadd8eee&e=d6c5c7d7ec) **7th Carroll County State House District
* _**Arkansas**_
* Alex Holladay**[flipped](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=bbd8e80de9&e=d6c5c7d7ec) **House District 70
* _**North Carolina**_
* Roy Cooper **[won](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=3366935338&e=d6c5c7d7ec) **the Democratic primary for U.S. Senate
* _**Texas**_
* James Talarico **[won](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=02d7a2b2dd&e=d6c5c7d7ec) **the Democratic primary for U.S. Senate
* _**Illinois**_
* Julianna Stratton **[won](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=2af2679fc6&e=d6c5c7d7ec)** the Democratic primary for U.S. Senate

---
|
---
| **Programmatic Updates**
* **DNC's Storytelling Program:** We’re inviting you and members of the community to join the DNC’s Storytellers Network, a new effort to elevate real experiences from working people and ensure our message reflects the lives we’re fighting for. _We are relying on you to share our storyteller form with your communities and ensure we have diverse voices:_ [https://win.dnc.org/storytellerform.](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=be92d121b2&e=d6c5c7d7ec)

* **BlueMatch:** The DNC launched [BlueMatch](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=60be409a74&e=d6c5c7d7ec) to connect talent with campaigns and state parties for the midterms. If you know talented staff who are seeking campaign work in 2026, encourage them to submit their resumes to our job banks: General 2026 Talent Bank:** [https://win.dnc.org/DNCTalentBank](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=22ece93656&e=d6c5c7d7ec)**
* **When We Count Fellowship:** This paid, [part-time youth fellowship](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=4b72fc44e2&e=d6c5c7d7ec) will train 300 supporters to register new Democratic voters, focusing on non-college youth often overlooked. It's the [DNC's largest voter registration program](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=b40bcbecc6&e=d6c5c7d7ec), supported by 18 partners and surrogates like LULAC, Senator Andy Kim, and Young Democrats of America, who promoted the launch via social media videos.
* **DNC NextWave Regional Bootcamp:** This is three-day, in-person training program that provides participants with specialized training based on their campaign experience level, and connects them with other campaign talent and professionals in their region. Four NextWave Regional Bootcamps will take place across the country in 2026. [LEARN MORE & APPLY HERE](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=654a089592&e=d6c5c7d7ec)

---
|
---
| **CALL TO ACTION** The DNC leans heavily on your engagement and support. Here’s how you can support our programming:
* Sign up and share the**[storyteller form](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=bbdf353627&e=d6c5c7d7ec) **in your networks
* Share this**[application link ](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=59a294f7a9&e=d6c5c7d7ec)**for the When We Count youth voter registration fellowship
* Share the**[sign-up link ](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=7a88b52964&e=d6c5c7d7ec)**for the Local Listeners Training Program
* Share our**[DNC Talent Bank link](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=000f30ddba&e=d6c5c7d7ec) **with anyone interested in getting involved with a 2026 campaign

---

---
|
---
| **ICYMI (In Case You Missed It)**
---
|
---
---
| **“Know Your Rights” Training:** We have partnered with several organizations to host “Know Your Rights” training. Just this past month, we partnered with Texas House Minority Leader, Gene Wu, Swifties for Hope, Every Vote Matters, and High School Democrats of America AANHPI Caucus to host virtual training sessions for their constituents.
---
|
---
---
| **Women’s History Month **
* On March 7th, the National Federation of Democratic Women, hosted DNC Vice Chairs Reyna Walters-Morgan, Shasti Conrad, and Artie Blanco for their annual “Women in Blue” Day, where they spoke on the importance of Women and conducted a voter protection and civic engagement training.
* On March 23rd, Women Forward hosted Chair Martin for a discussion on the DNC strategy ahead of midterms and the importance women have in the party.

---
|
---
| **Grassroot Organization Partnerships:** On March 18th, Steve Schear hosted a national call recruiting grassroots organizers for the DNC When We Count and Local Listeners programs. Chair Martin also spoke on the DNC strategy ahead of midterms and the importance of organizing in your state. Over 500 people joined the call!
---
|
---
---
| **New DNC Council Programming**
* The DNC Seniors Council hosted a Scam Prevention Training to address the rise in election and voting scams targeting seniors across the country.
* The DNC Rural Council hosted a Regional Rural Forum, a program for rural county parties, rural caucuses, and rural Dems to share and learn best practices.

Marlene

Marlene Galán-Woods is a former broadcast journalist and mother of five who has lived in Arizona for the past 36 years. Her parents fled communist Cuba looking for a better life. She met the love of her life, Grant Woods, and they raised a family together before he passed away in 2021. Marlene is running for Congress to stand up to extremists and be a voice for all Arizonans. | | | | | [](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010qvzJOODwMPY9rGQadVUhJ7VKhCfVdT5xCsGrt-V2ik3YkmBVnLto3-0G2LIUjz-idCXIVkG-SOtXBCfbW-0adTYSP_jCTnVwNwUZaLy6fo1x3zMNVZsR1EBcIOkrapzzUCJAox1sqqEvBJHN0MYWEE1ak9IguAgiKl23LQY3FCND9ElMdT3SasBP5UZIkrUx8w-GoEwNF0KZp2nyWsc-2oIcgIbx2-r&c=UGL7bgY5rfu0bWcWer8Vjb8StM707QHoeD7ABe7h3j__UxRq5tQW0Q==&ch=vupQQW40lj2bMIysikYsHHeoAzSFhLh0iJDz4jf_AeBeaEwQRoGOJQ==)

| Peter, it seems like Donald Trump wakes up every morning thinking of new, more embarrassing ways to bring shame to our country and the office of the President.
Yesterday, Trump shared an image of himself as Jesus healing the sick. I know it sounds too bizarre to be real, but it is:
---
| [](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010qvzJOODwMPY9rGQadVUhJ7VKhCfVdT5xCsGrt-V2ik3YkmBVnLto3-0G2LIUjz-idCXIVkG-SOtXBCfbW-0adTYSP_jCTnVwNwUZaLy6fo1x3zMNVZsR1EBcIOkrapzzUCJAox1sqqEvBJHN0MYWEE1ak9IguAgiKl23LQY3FCND9ElMdT3SasBP5UZIkrUx8w-GoEwNF07cMhvTOXP7q_51lQIBlN_&c=UGL7bgY5rfu0bWcWer8Vjb8StM707QHoeD7ABe7h3j__UxRq5tQW0Q==&ch=vupQQW40lj2bMIysikYsHHeoAzSFhLh0iJDz4jf_AeBeaEwQRoGOJQ==)
---
Frankly, this is deeply upsetting for a number of reasons. First off, Donald Trump is one of the least Christ-like individuals I've ever had the misfortune of learning about.
I have read the Bible enough to know that Jesus preached a message of love, peace, and caring for the poor, the weak, and the sick.
Donald Trump does NONE of those things.
I grew up in the church in rural Louisiana. My faith taught me humility, service, and compassion for those less fortunate. The idea that Donald Trump -- a man who embodies greed, cruelty, and vanity -- would compare himself to Jesus Christ is not just offensive.
It's BLASPHEMY!
It also tells you everything you need to know about where his head is right now.
This isn't the behavior of a competent leader. This is desperation. This is a man who knows he's losing, who knows the country has turned against him, who knows his policies are failing -- so he resorts to the most grotesque form of ego worship imaginable.
I'm running for Senate to defeat the kind of politics Trump represents. Not just his policies -- though those are bad enough -- but the moral rot at the center of the MAGA movement.
Louisiana deserves better. America deserves better. And we deserve leaders who actually live by the values they claim to hold.

Look, Donald Trump’s trigger-happy approach to war is putting troops in harm’s way, raising prices at the pump, and violating federal law. But he doesn’t give a damn.

From unauthorized military strikes in Venezuela to escalating the war in Iran, the administration is acting outside legal bounds, answering to no one, and launching high-stakes military actions without Congress’s approval or consent.

**Our country was built on a system of checks and balances to prevent any one person from holding unchecked power over war and peace, but right now, those guardrails are being tested. **

When Donald Trump defrauded the people of New York, I took him to court and held him accountable. And as Trump and extreme Republicans ramp up their attacks on everything we stand for – threatening immigrants’ rights, raising prices for working people, and launching efforts to roll back voting rights – I’m using the full power of the attorney general’s office to fight back. That’s why it’s no surprise Donald Trump is targeting me. He knows I won’t stop holding him and his administration accountable, and he’s mobilizing the entire weight of the Department of Justice to come after me because of it. But if there’s one thing I’ve learned, it's that you can never back down from a bully. I’m running for reelection, Peter, and I need you on my side to keep fighting for the rights of New Yorkers and people all across this country. | Together, we’ll keep up the fight for justice, progress, and equality. Thank you, Tish James Attorney General of New York | We’re facing a critical moment in American history, which means what we do right now will define the future of our nation and our world. Here at Blue Amp, we’re dedicated to uplifting the movers and shakers who will defend our shared democratic values and beat back against right-wing authoritarianism. We’re amplifying good candidates who are passionate about protecting civil rights, making life affordable, and leaving a better world for future generations. The midterms are coming up, and we can’t do this work without you. With your support, we'll work to halt the right-wing agenda and support strong Democrats who will fight for us across the country. Friend, My commitment to fighting for an end to the genocide in Gaza is something that I won't budge on. When I was in the EPA, I worked to prevent the dumping of toxic chemical waste into water along the U.S.-Mexico border, and I've seen what happens when poisonous water is all that's left for people to use—** _it's horrendous._** In Gaza, Israel has been intentionally depriving Palestinians of water, using it as a weapon of war. And of the little that is available, much of it is poisoned by toxic sewage and debris due to environmental devastation. **_Believe me when I say that even if the bombs stop, failing to provide the people of Gaza with clean water will only continue this genocide._** Friend, by speaking out, powerful lobbying groups like AIPAC, who have millions of dollars ready to spend on races like ours, will see us as an enemy. **But I'm not afraid of AIPAC, and their money won't stop me from fighting for what's right.** [**Can you help me fight any outside spending from these groups and be a strong anti-genocide voice in Congress by supporting our campaign today?**](https://heidihall.us/l/bnDOk8ARKgk9)

Raised by parents who had persisted to make a middle-class life for their kids in Contra Costa County while lifting up others, Heidi was taught to push through and overcome challenges rather than complain about them. She learned to stick up for the vulnerable, to respect working people, and to value equal opportunity and justice.

After graduating from Pomona College and earning graduate degrees from Columbia and Rutgers, Heidi went to work for the Rockefeller Foundation promoting reproductive care and then began her career at the Environmental Protection Agency, stopping the dumping of toxic waste and holding corporate polluters accountable.

Today, Heidi chairs the Nevada County Board of Supervisors, where she’s taken on homelessness, expanded broadband access, and worked to reduce crime and illegal cannabis growth. Heidi flipped her seat from red to blue – and now she’s ready to do it again in Congress to take on toxic politics in Washington and put people first.

Kristina Parker, Communications Director for the Maine Republican Party, and Garrick Hoffman, Director of Digital Media at the Maine Policy Institute, discuss Maine's reliance on federal matching funds, particularly in Medicaid, and how that may shape state policy decisions. Hoffman suggests the system creates little incentive to control spending, while Parker points to rising costs that continue to be passed on to residents.

clean_body: A once-in-a-lifetime Memorial Day for America and our veterans| | | Peter, It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250th birthday. Peter, this Memorial Day marks the first major national act of remembrance of the veterans who made the ultimate sacrifice to defend America from its enemies and ensure it has remained the Land of the Free for the last 250 years. And this year's National Memorial Day Parade will be a special edition - the biggest parade yet - where national memory meets living history as veterans from every military generation celebrate America and honor the service and sacrifice of their fallen brethren. Peter, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous patriots like you. The 2026 National Memorial Day Parade is a once-in-a-lifetime moment where we need to do all we can to honor our country and our veterans. Bigger crowds. More veterans. More young people learning what courage, service, and sacrifice really mean. Historically, AVC has been able to do this at a fraction of what other major public events cost to put on each year. In fact, the entire parade costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl Parade! That means that every dollar that's contributed by a generous American like you makes a difference for this important event. But I want to reiterate that American Veterans Center does not take ANY federal funding for this event. It is funded entirely by private citizens like you who want to honor those who have sacrificed so much for our country. | | Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the parade, but also supports great programs like: Record hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to today before we lose these stories forever. Hold our annual American Veterans Conference, which allows young cadets a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, Vietnam, and our modern wars. Produce veteran-focused T.V. documentaries and specials that remind Americans the price of our freedom. But of course, the National Memorial Day Parade is AVC's flagship event honoring America's veterans. And this year's parade will be the largest in their history of hosting the parade. If you've been looking for an opportunity to give back to those who have given so much for our freedom, this is one of the best possible ways you could do it. And for a special group of veterans, this might be one of the last chances we get. You see, with each year that goes by, we lose more and more of our World War II veterans, and for the few we have remaining, traveling to Washington, D.C., for the parade is difficult. | | | | | WWII veterans were a key part of the first parade when it was revived in 2005, as they have been every year since for the last 20 years. But this may be the last year we have the opportunity to have these brave men and women with us for the parade. This year is a rare moment when living witnesses to World War II and America 's 250**th birthday overlap. And no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you. On Memorial Day - not just this momentous year of military milestones, but every year - please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. There's no better send-off we can give them than to make sure they're present to honor their fallen brethren during America's 250th birthday. | Hi Peter,

**This weekend, the President made up fantastic lies about me and the work we are doing in Virginia.**

**Why?** Because he’s trying to distract from the rising costs and hurt that so many Americans are feeling because of his chaotic policies.

And the truth is that since taking office, I’ve signed dozens of bipartisan bills into law to lower costs and make life more affordable for Virginia families by:
* Cracking down on middlemen who inflate the price of **prescription medications**
* Expanding the supply of **housing** that working Virginians can actually afford
* Shielding families from unfair cost increases tied to **energy system** upgrades
* Giving local communities more tools to increase access to **affordable housing**
* Supporting investments that strengthen Virginia’s **energy independence**
* Building up our **healthcare workforce** so more Virginians can access care

We’ve also accelerated $7.1 billion in capital investment projects that will bring more than **3,250 jobs** to our Commonwealth – real progress that supports families and communities across Virginia.

**While he lies, I’m focused on delivering stability, lowering costs, and making sure Virginia is a place where families can get ahead.**

But continuing this work – and supporting leaders who are willing to do it — takes resources.

[_**If you believe in this approach, I hope you’ll stand with me today. Blockade Holds, Ceasefire Talks Restart

The [U.S. naval blockade of Iranian ports](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLGK7CAYhZ_GdAb99WpSWNzGbrbdMjjxz4xgNKiJsE-_ZB5huwMfnI9zvh_Lw4UY0uvL7WjWKyw--6V2FzvGWLCGV6qtnPux4enrAgwUZZJyuaS4wODN6pWAAQ3XWgETINjwNjArxTcpJ69nIZ2buVOgn4jTprdZ-CGYu4lJLoFLzaZRu3_TBE_O1CZWVJ5Idh7eNazjmlPFcrkWLgwp5TvlNK55H6J5t3ZUIv4TsARs731c04cRsLeCgGWSgOXixrlET8DGcCFN2CsBG4pL9Ky0u0I_Q-k7l_38GYrxRw8xhqo0key1uxA_0vaHny4DvwEAAP__EQ52mw) went into effect Monday at 10 a.m. ET after peace talks in Pakistan collapsed--Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps has vowed to retaliate. Iran then offered a [5-year suspension of nuclear activity](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckDGO8yAUhE-DO1vwIOC_oPgbumy7pYXNS_IkDBYQo739yjnCdlPMzKeZ7_ty9xQpPb_8jnY7aQk5LLX72DHGgpWeqbby3o8HvkNdgIMeuRqFWlJcYAh2C1rCgFYYo4FLkHx4WRG8QXNTNyO95nJdheAz_NMBZmPEug5kryauhAKhDJ8n42_zDKvg-iE31IEp_j6Cb1inLaeK5fSNTqSU8qVymra8D9G-Wjsqk_8ZOAau9z6ln0b7J7YzcJFOZOAuGgPHFQMn5OXMJQYGjopPY_dl_IwcE_Y6FBuOTjFS1YYp_tw9xQ-u_eGh08JvAAAA__8IOHP9) as an off-ramp; VP Vance had sought 20 years, and Trump rejected the proposal outright. The U.S. is now exploring a [second round of ceasefire talks](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLuunDAQhp8GOqPxJcAWLtLQbdqUyIwH1lpjI9tgKU8fsTrnBU736dNc_7_P-Wmcd2H7Y3bSeLnZRjvnanwl7xNlt4Vc0rkfK502zwJEz0AxrubgZ9FajbaXoiXNh6EXIIWE9qUJSFgJ44OvHFAtsK4PXCT0wCVHjq3T9yRQXAmuBhi7wfwaR7Fw6FeJ1NtGwXlYUyh3GEOmdJniLnIhxJti6DDurdevUo7cyN-NmBox1Vq7sGCgerftt4nJ20ZMLpnQiMm7i9ji4_bNX0vYmW-Nb2OJ3bXsiKlk9nmdvWLaz3_sIIPEivHvzJBMptUlYgmDkZKrQbZJ26M6713uh0bBthvnP3eWH0R7afE_AAD__8aAi6o) even as the blockade holds--the conflict is in its seventh week with no clear off-ramp in sight. ★★★

Trump attacked [Pope Leo XIV on Truth Social](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckD2O7CAQhE-DMyzc4J8XELyEbDbd0GKgPdNaDMgw5vor-wiblfRJ9anq-7E-LAWKry-7o3YnrT75tTQbGoZwYKFXLPX47HnDjy8rCJi4UHxQawwrdF47P0noUA_zPIGQIEX31vhvWUD6cUMFT28BNgtiFLPEETewS0f6ahJqUDCoWSz9bMdlgecgpk06nDxT4pO9rVh6l2LB47SVTqQY05VS7F3au6DftebC5H8GhoFprfUu3oyBuRQMjFAMzAAMTE6BKrnCwNybeE4ZecDE3XEBKjt_xx9OsYbu0D43CoHKNDMlXrulcEvrH346NfwGAAD__5EUd0U) as "WEAK on crime" and "terrible for Foreign Policy" after the pontiff called for peace in the Iran war. The first American pope fired back, saying he has ["no fear of the Trump administration"](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLHOrCAUhJ8GOw0c-NEtKG5jt7e9pTnrOeuSIBBAff0b9xH-bjKZzJeZf8_liT74uP3Fnd16-oUSLfXCcHEIhavfYm3l2PObD6oLSLC9NL0ySwwLdORWsho6dmocLUgNWnYfRy890Wv90YokSa3t42EZ0I7S4JuU6by7m6RRBpQZ5TSM-DNN8FLSvvXKloSRRyZsXIc1xcrlxOZP9jGmW6U4rGnvgvu0lqvQfwTMAubruob24e3AQh6_mdtNJZCA-UYKmDEXAbPSAmZKEQP134F9Tpn7wKkrjvLlQ_DVjsLIbUcfvrj2i4dOB_8DAAD__wTpdVQ) and will continue speaking out against the conflict. Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni--among Trump's closest European allies--publicly called [the criticism "unacceptable,"](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyc0LFuwyAUheGnwVssuGBwBoYu3tK1o4W5NwkSBstg07595T5Ct1860jecr8f8cCGG9Pp0K1l_hhkzzqW52CjGnUp4pVL3Y92edGCZgYO-cXUTak5xhg6tRy2hIyuM0cAlSN69LSK5u5LaLVJ7kmrwKAZhnsKhkHctumAviSuhQCjDx964YRxhEVw_pSeNTPFjQ1ep9D6nQvvpajgppJSvyqn3ee2ifde6FSY_GEwMptZavyz-2hhMiVphMLm9Bh_pSr-NSvxw04bv3O0WtxZiDEUbpvhrdSH-qfUfR5wWfgMAAP__RmZtHw) with the pope's rebuke carrying particular weight given Catholics account for roughly 40% of Congress. ★★★

Tony Gonzales [announced resignations within hours of each other](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLGunTAMQL8mbL4KJk3owNCF7XXtiExi7osUEhSHS_v3FbfqD7zNg-Vzjn99LB8UU8zPn7Tz5F9xCSUsclG6OKXKEp9ZWj33Y-MzyIIaLWgDvVlyWrALkw92wI6n3jmLesBBd5_TarHHwX4Po3auZxc0unXTmx1XY8hhF6f7kja9wd44PT4cfRtHXHttt8GzDcro8wjUWB6-ZOH6ohZfHHMu91Tyw5e9S9Nna4eo4YfCWeF8XddjrRzbSrXdGwrno6TYoheF881UOGujcO4HhTPX6OF_LQj9EYhwJMrQCvyrh62WHXzJz8oiQFvjCtIq0w5lA-HfJyUgETpTA_L-lLffzevqFI4rphTFOmX0c6eY3uLtC79-Tfg3AAD__556kFQ) on Monday, both facing House Ethics Committee probes into sexual misconduct allegations. Swalwell's departure kills his California gubernatorial campaign; [Gonzales, a Texas Republican,](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLGO6yAURL8Gd47gQsCvoHgNXbbd0iJw7SBdgwXEUfbrV979g-1GGmmO5nze5ptPlPL64Te04UhzLHFuL08vJKrY0ppbr89tX_AZ2wwc9MjVKNScaYYh2hC1hAGtMEYDlyD58LBXAIlGTkLyBUNU-vpPL14HFc09ikUPyZ5LXAkFQhk-XYy_ThPcBdeLDKgjU_y5R9-xXULJDevhezow5VzOVPIllG0g--h9b0z-Z-AYuOgTvYMnwnr2DNyJYeC4YuCEZOB6ye9xLfnLE7bx9-EYSl4rtsbADdXG_ZWIUtOGKb5uPtEPrP_Bz2HhOwAA___QsXRA) announced his retirement shortly after, with bipartisan expulsion votes looming for both. # **NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani admits city-run grocery stores will only guarantee lower prices on "essential basket of goods"**
Mayor Zohran Mamdani **[admitted Tuesday](https://substack.com/redirect/7decfdcc-a988-4cdf-a59b-1ea47033f0b9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that his city-owned grocery stores will only guarantee cheaper prices for "an essential basket of goods," not all products, with the first location at La Marqueta in East Harlem carrying a "whopping $30 million" price tag and not opening until 2029. The La Marqueta store will be a 9,000-square-foot market built from the ground up on a vacant lot, officials said, while other municipal stores are expected to open before then, with the first greeting shoppers in late 2027.

City Hall officials plan to tap a private operator to manage the stores' daily operations.

* **What 's guaranteed**: Mamdani said the price of a "core basket of goods"--which he and City Hall officials didn't specify--will be fixed to provide "predictability of price" and help people budget. The mayor has pitched the stores as an affordability measure to tackle "often-volatile" grocery prices, though critics have questioned the massive public investment.

It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 _ _ and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY - but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. **But I've never been more excited to serve as an Honorary Grand Marshall than I am this year - the year of America's 250****th**** birthday.**

body:
We didn't just hit the bar — we cleared it by a mile.
# [](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/685?refcode=&t=1&akid=4459%2E898137%2Ezv2cDI)
I just filed my paperwork to get on the ballot for the U.S. Senate — and I have to be honest with you, it felt really good.
[](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/4?c0=mam-em-april2026.vCnu4h&refcode=AU_MAM_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260414_PM1_V1_S1&t=2&akid=4459%2E898137%2Ezv2cDI)
Turning in these signatures was a team effort powered by people like you:
✅ While state law requires a minimum of 15,000 signatures, our volunteers collected and turned in **30,000** — the absolute maximum allowed by the State of Michigan.
✅ The law only requires signatures from half of Michigan's Congressional districts and we blew past that by collecting signatures from **all 83 counties** , from Detroit to the UP.
✅ We hit these record-breaking numbers with **100% volunteer power** — no paid canvassers, just neighbors talking to neighbors.
Momentum is real, and it's ours right now. But momentum doesn't maintain itself — it takes hard, sustained work.
I'm one person. But together? We are a movement — and this November, we are going to protect this seat, take back the Senate, and send Mike Rogers back home to Florida.

body:
and I need your help!

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mikevansomeren/working-families-cant-do-it-alone-10144814?e=356c0699dd)

| | | | | |

Friends,Campaign season is fully upon us. Starting this Wednesday, April 15th, candidates for the November election can collect nomination signatures to get them officially on the ballot; and I need your help to do it!I’ll be working with the Democratic Party of Wisconsin to go door to door, asking strong Democratic supporters across my district to sign my nomination papers. All signatures are due on June 1st, and the earlier we can collect them the better.
I’ll be out knocking doors this weekend to collect the signatures we need to get on the ballot, and I’d love to have you join me. We need to hit this goal soon, and every signature matters. I’ll have all the materials ready, so you can just show up and help. If you’re short on time, feel free to stop by one of the locations below to meet us and sign the nomination papers.If you can’t make it this weekend but still want to help, fill out the form below and we’ll get nomination papers to you so you can collect signatures on your own schedule.
Saturday, April 18th
* 10:00am - 11:00am at the Waukesha County Democratic Party Office, 336 Wisconsin Avenue, Waukesha
* 2:30pm - 3:30pm at the Washington County Democratic Party Office, 132 North Main Street, West Bend

Sunday, April 19th
* 1:00pm at the Jefferson County Democratic Party office, 109 North 3rd Street, Watertown

**RSVP to join me here:**[**https://forms.gle/LUiGThZs1aq4ti4Q7**](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=b50cc27836&e=356c0699dd)
_Note: Only residents of the_[ _33rd State Senate District_](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=f8a15d78a4&e=356c0699dd) _can sign nomination papers, but anyone is welcome to volunteer!_ While this is a small step in my overall campaign, it also presents the biggest barrier to getting on the ballot in November. My campaign is built on being for the people, and I look forward to seeing you on the doors as I take the first real step in giving voters a good choice in our next election.
\- Mike
**P.S.** Even 30 minutes makes a difference. If you can swing by, we’d love to have you.
**P.P.S.** Can’t make it? Fill out the form and we’ll get you nomination papers to help on your own time.

name: Christina (personal)
subject: Thinking about gratitude
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY CHRISTINA BOHANNAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
| Peter,

Campaigns are never easy. They are a heavy lift in every sense of the word, built not just on long days and hard work, but on the belief that something better is possible. It asks people to carve time out of their already busy lives, to show up, to speak out, and to invest in a future we all share.

That's why I've been thinking a lot lately about gratitude.

I am so grateful for you and for everyone who has been a part of this movement. Whether you've volunteered your time, read one of these emails, signed a petition, or made a donation, you have helped us build something that means so much. **It moves me more than I can fully express to know that this campaign is bringing people together, that it's something people believe in and are excited to be part of.**

Our district deserves better. And as we grow, we are showing Mariannette Miller-Meeks that her days of throwing our neighbors under the bus are numbered. People are ready for change, and they're stepping up to make it happen.

But I want to be honest with you – finishing this race and sealing the deal in November is going to take even more. It will take resources, persistence, and a continued commitment from this team we've built together. We've come so far, and I hope I can continue to count on you as we keep growing and reaching more voters.

**We're working to hit our $15,000 mid-month goal before midnight tonight. body:
MAGA is using every tool it has to rig the 2026 midterm elections. | |

Peter, **Trump and the****ext****remist MAGA elites backing him have officially pulled out every tool in the voter suppression toolbook.** First, they began racially gerrymandering districts across the country, starting in Texas and Florida. Their redrawn districts essentially conjured brand new, solid red districts out of thin air by strategically disenfranchising historically Democratic voters. Then, they said they were thinking about deploying ICE agents to polling places. The effect? Chilling voter turnout in the immigrant communities who are fed up with Trump’s abuse. **They’re currently in the midst of strong-arming the captured Supreme Court to gut the _Voting Rights Act_ , which would open the floodgates for their gerrymandering efforts and lock in all those new red districts. ** And now, Trump has signed an Executive Order taking over elections, creating a “citizen list” determining who can vote, and instructing the Post Office to refuse ballots to anyone not on the list. Millions of eligible voters are at risk of being left off the list. Add this to his dangerous “stolen election” rhetoric, MAGA’s mass disinformation, and his attempt to redefine who counts as an American, and we have a full-on attack on our elections. **Without the unfettered****right to vote in free and fair elections, we don’t have a democracy at all. That’s his entire goal.** [**It’s up to us to put massive pressure on Congress to defend our democracy—before it’s too late. Now, the Trump administration has made a bet that the Supreme Court will give them the green light to manipulate voting districts and disenfranchise voters to the point where 2026 midterm election success is guaranteed. We’re still waiting for the decision in Louisiana v. Callais to come down, but we’re already prepared to create a massive wave in response. But if all else fails, Trump has his Executive Order determining who gets to vote and stripping the ballot from anyone who doesn’t make the cut. The Constitution gives states the power to administer elections, not the federal government—but Trump doesn’t care. Thank you for standing up for voting rights, Morgan Stahr United for Democracy Paid for by United for Democracy. | | Sent via . **[Missed Gold’s Big Move? This Pullback May Not Be Random](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e22512091/VaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5hbGxlZ2lhbmNlZ29sZC5jb20vZ29sZC1zdHJhdGVneS0yMDI2LWpyd2EtZGVkLw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA0MTQ/LbmNsbnpCU0tCaw/gad6-dQ/scn950ec764)** **If you feel like you missed gold’s recent surge... you’re not alone.** Many investors watched prices climb and assumed the opportunity had already passed. But markets don’t move in straight lines. And what’s happening right now may be more important than the move itself. **Something Unusual Is Happening** Recently, both **stocks and gold moved higher... and are now pulling back at the same time.** That’s not typical. Historically, gold and equities tend to move in opposite directions. But when they rise - and even correct - together, it has often appeared during periods of underlying stress in the financial system. We saw similar patterns:
* **In 1999,** before the tech bubble correction
* **In 2007,** before the financial crisis

While no two cycles are identical, these moments tend to get the attention of experienced investors. **[Why This Pullback May Matter](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e22512091/VaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5hbGxlZ2lhbmNlZ29sZC5jb20vZ29sZC1zdHJhdGVneS0yMDI2LWpyd2EtZGVkLw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA0MTQ/LbmNsbnpCU0tCaw/gad6-dQ/scn950ec764)** Gold has pulled back slightly in recent weeks. On the surface, that may seem like weakness. But historically, in uncertain environments, these types of pullbacks have often been **short-term pauses—not long-term reversals.** At the same time, several forces continue building:
* Inflation remains persistent
* Energy markets are becoming more volatile
* Global tensions continue to rise
* Interest rates remain elevated
* National debt continues expanding

**[These are the same types of conditions that have previously increased interest in tangible assets like gold.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e22512091/VaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5hbGxlZ2lhbmNlZ29sZC5jb20vZ29sZC1zdHJhdGVneS0yMDI2LWpyd2EtZGVkLw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA0MTQ/LbmNsbnpCU0tCaw/gad6-dQ/scn950ec764)** When markets become uncertain, not all investors react the same way. Some wait for clarity. Others pay attention to early signals—and use periods of volatility to reassess their positioning. No one can predict markets with certainty. But historically, these types of environments have been closely watched by those focused on long-term wealth preservation. To help break this down, a new **[2026 Gold Strategy Guide](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e22512091/VaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5hbGxlZ2lhbmNlZ29sZC5jb20vZ29sZC1zdHJhdGVneS0yMDI2LWpyd2EtZGVkLw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA0MTQ/LbmNsbnpCU0tCaw/gad6-dQ/scn950ec764)** has just been released. This free guide explains:
* Why gold pulled back—and what similar moments have looked like historically
* How inflation, energy, and global tensions may impact future trends
* What some investors are considering in today’s environment

This may not be about trying to time the market perfectly. # What’s Missing in West Virginia?

---
|
---
|
---
| |
Dear Friend,

**At a certain point, leadership isn’t measured by what gets announced—**
**it’s measured by what actually shows up.**
Not in press releases. Not in committee approvals.
**But in the lives of the people who were told help was on the way.**
Across West Virginia, more people are asking:
**After all this time... where exactly are we being led?**
Projects are announced. Funding gets approved.
**Yet too often, the results don’t reach the people who need them most.**
This isn’t about effort.
**It’s about direction.**
I’ll be sharing more in the coming days.
But for now:
**West Virginia doesn’t need more announcements.****
It needs results.**
**And it’s time for a change!**
Sincerely,
**Tom Willis**

name: Nico, United We Dream
subject: We will not stay silent
body:
Undocumented students have been left in limbo. | | | Peter,
In our ongoing series this month, we’ll explain, point by point, the threats DACA recipients are currently facing. One of the main issues that undocumented youth face is the ability to obtain higher education. That access has been eroded by the administration, as changes in executive orders and federal regulations have made significant impacts on college access, funding, and enrollment. The DOJ has challenged policies in different states that offer financial aid to undocumented students, including DACA recipients. It sued California last November for offering in-state tuition benefits for undocumented immigrant students, following similar actions against tuition practices in Texas, Kentucky, Illinois, Oklahoma, and Minnesota. The Department of Education has opened investigations into five universities (the University of Louisville, the University of Nebraska at Omaha, the University of Miami, the University of Michigan, and Western Michigan University) for offering scholarships to DACA recipients, arguing that these policies discriminate against other students. There are over 500,000 undocumented students enrolled in higher education institutions in the country, many of whom rely on accessibility and affordability measures and policies established in their states and universities. Access has already been rescinded in Florida by the state legislature and in Texas, via court settlement with the DOJ, after the state legislature failed to pass a bill. The administration’s challenges have left undocumented students in limbo. They don’t have access to federal financial aid and are often forced to pay out-of-state rates, creating a financial gap that leads to high dropout rates. Many students face constant fear of deportation and ICE raids, which disrupts their studies and creates psychological distress. In the face of these challenges, we know that the power to initiate real change rests with us — the people. **We know that the strength and resilience of our communities can create a future where we can all thrive.** ******[We will continue working to protect not only DACA recipients, but all immigrant youth, including those who have not been able to take advantage of the policy, Peter. clean_body: Undocumented students have been left in limbo. | | | Peter, In our ongoing series this month, we’ll explain, point by point, the threats DACA recipients are currently facing. One of the main issues that undocumented youth face is the ability to obtain higher education. That access has been eroded by the administration, as changes in executive orders and federal regulations have made significant impacts on college access, funding, and enrollment. The DOJ has challenged policies in different states that offer financial aid to undocumented students, including DACA recipients. It sued California last November for offering in-state tuition benefits for undocumented immigrant students, following similar actions against tuition practices in Texas, Kentucky, Illinois, Oklahoma, and Minnesota. The Department of Education has opened investigations into five universities (the University of Louisville, the University of Nebraska at Omaha, the University of Miami, the University of Michigan, and Western Michigan University) for offering scholarships to DACA recipients, arguing that these policies discriminate against other students. There are over 500,000 undocumented students enrolled in higher education institutions in the country, many of whom rely on accessibility and affordability measures and policies established in their states and universities. Access has already been rescinded in Florida by the state legislature and in Texas, via court settlement with the DOJ, after the state legislature failed to pass a bill. The administration’s challenges have left undocumented students in limbo. They don’t have access to federal financial aid and are often forced to pay out-of-state rates, creating a financial gap that leads to high dropout rates. Many students face constant fear of deportation and ICE raids, which disrupts their studies and creates psychological distress. In the face of these challenges, we know that the power to initiate real change rests with us — the people. We know that the strength and resilience of our communities can create a future where we can all thrive. **** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | | Thank you for stepping up and joining us at such a crucial time. There is a difference between panic and preparation.
Panic is performative. It scatters. It hoards. It makes fools of people.
Preparation is sober. It looks clearly at risk, tells the truth about fragility, and takes the next wise step.
That is where I am tonight. Let me tell you why.
My research has been revealing. The closure of the Strait of Hormuz - which controls over 20% of the world's oil supply _and over 30% of the global fertilizer**** trade **-**_**may be** **just the beginning.** The IEA has already warned that this is the largest oil supply shock in history.
We are already feeling the pressure at the gas pump, but those prices have **not yet** propagated fully through our supply chains. Fuel costs have been hit, yes - nearly doubling in some places. Diesel in Seattle just, today, hit $7/gallon, setting a new record. But **food costs** do not yet reflect this change. They will. It's a matter of time. The diesel required to transport the food and consumer goods we depend on has just doubled in price. There's no way that doesn't show up in grocery prices, it's just a matter of when.
For context: the Strait of Hormuz has been closed a long time now, and tanker ships take a long time to cross the world. **Some markets have been cushioned by cargoes loaded before the disruptions, but that buffer is now coming to an end.**
After that... we're in unprecedented territory.
Some of the world's most important refining hubs -- especially in India and across export-oriented Asia -- have cut output, suspended cargoes, or declared force majeure as feedstock disruptions ripple out from the Middle East. That means some shipments of gasoline, diesel, and jet fuel that were supposed to reach Australia, parts of Africa, Asia-Pacific, and Europe are not moving as planned.
At a technical level, the core of the issue is a mismatch between _**type of**_ supply and demand in the intricate and entwined processing requirements of the global oil & gas industry. What America produces domestically (light sweet crude), we are less equipped to _process_ domestically. Most of our refineries were built to handle "heavy, sour crude" \- which Venezuela has, which perhaps explains some events earlier this year. Despite our net surplus of _other types_ of oil, America **does** rely on imported fossil fuel - and that imported fuel which our country requires to meet our domestic energy needs **is now squarely in the crosshairs,** thanks to our president's war on Iran.
Oil and gas is _not_ my area of expertise, so I learn from others, including the technical analyst linked below. What he expects we'll face will be _either_ reduced production entirely, as refineries decide not to process what they are not set up to handle - _or_ a massive, physical oversupply of a hydrocarbon the modern world is not set up to use: naphtha. And whether this takes the form of simple scarcity or physical oversupply of the wrong thing, the world's ability to move and use the most dense energy source we have, that our societies require daily in order to function - will come under strain such as none of us have experienced before.
The Ultimate Avatar of Balance
[The Naphtha Heart Attack: Why $120 WTI is a Ghost Signal Preceding a Negative-Price Inversion](https://substack.com/redirect/bb72155b-a21e-4e18-9bca-dff615af923d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Over the past week, joint US-Israeli kinetic strikes have begun systematically targeting and destroying key Iranian hydrocarbon infrastructure. This is not a mere geopolitical standoff or a temporary naval blockade that can be resolved at a negotiating table; there is no longer a diplomatic 'reverse gear'. The physical exergy source is being vaporised...
[Read more](https://substack.com/redirect/bb72155b-a21e-4e18-9bca-dff615af923d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
a month ago * 126 likes * 42 comments * Steven J. Newbury
That article is a dense read packed with technical details and industry jargon, but the bottom line deserves to be underlined: if the global oil and gas system seizes up like this, we're not looking at a tidy "price increase" story for cable news to chatter over. **It will hit the absolute foundations of ordinary life** : trucking, fertilizer, food distribution, heating, emergency services, medical supply chains, and the invisible logistics that hold modern society together.
And the people who will feel it first - and worst - will not be hedge funds or Pentagon contractors. It will be working families. Elders on fixed incomes. Parents with babies. Disabled people who rely on refrigerated medicine, powered devices, or regular deliveries. Small farmers. Hourly workers. Everybody already living too close to the edge.
That is the moral fact that matters.
I want to be careful here. The article above makes a sweeping and highly technical case about refinery bottlenecks, fuel chemistry, and systemic seizure. Some of those claims may prove right, some may prove overstated, and some may be impossible for most of us to independently verify in real time. But we do not need every detail to be perfect to recognize the broader truth:
**We have built our lives on abundant dense energy.
That abundance is already disrupted.
If it gets worse, the damage will cascade fast.**
That is not alarmism. That is systems thinking.
A gallon of fuel is not just a gallon of fuel. It is farm equipment. It is trucking. It is refrigeration. It is ambulance routing. It is grocery restocking. It is home heat in cold places. It is the supply chain behind medicine, infant formula, and spare parts. It is the quiet layer of "of course it's there" that most people only notice when it isn't.
So yes: if you have propane tanks and you can refill them responsibly, refill them. If your vehicle is low and you have the cash, fill it up. Buy a sack or two of oats, beans, and rice at Winco. (Don't forget salt, sugar, chocolate, oil, garlic, powdered eggs, powdered milk, and more of your favorite spices. Or your migraine meds, your kids' Tylenol, hydrogen peroxide, and iodine to purify water.)
Do not wait until the warning becomes a headline everyone is reacting to at once. If you rely on prescription medication, do what you can to get ahead of your supply. If your pantry is thin, strengthen it. If your livestock or animals depend on bagged feed, think ahead. If you have no backup way to cook food or boil water, that is worth solving now.
Collapse is not guaranteed tomorrow morning.
But _prudence is part of citizenship_.

* * *
One of the ugliest habits in this country is that we leave ordinary people to improvise through foreseeable shocks while the people who actually profit from fragility call it "efficiency" and leave the rest of us holding the bag.
No. "Efficiency" is not a god, and **resilience is not a slogan**. It is stocked medicine, fuel in the tank, food in the house, water on hand, a charged battery bank, a plan for elders, a phone tree, neighbors who know each other, and a realistic understanding of what your household would do if stores thinned out or deliveries slowed down for two weeks. And ideally, with enough buffer to live through two hard months. And a plan for who you trust and respect -- who you'd team up with if you had to figure out what to do to survive two years without most of the supply chains that have made possible much of what we call "modern life."
Friends: I wish I was kidding. I am not.
* * *
If you are wondering what to actually do, here is the plain version.
**Start with the essentials.**
Food you already eat.
Extra calories that store well: peanut butter, dried fruit and nuts, protein powder.
Spices, herbs, salt, sugar, honey, hot sauce.
Remember cooking oil and long-shelf-life fats.
Water storage and purification.
Any critical medications, as well as the basic ones.
Backup cooking fuel.
A safe amount of vehicle fuel, following local law and actual fire safety.
Feed and supplies for animals.
Cash on hand if electronic systems get weird.
Basic lights, batteries, and ways to charge phones.
Warmth if you live somewhere cold.
**Then move to the second ring.**
Who in your orbit would be hit hardest?
An elderly neighbor?
A single mom?
A disabled friend?
Someone without a car?
Someone whose English is limited and who may get information late?
Preparation that stops at your own front door is not enough. A decent society is built by people who think one house beyond themselves.
